" alt="CareWithJohn"><h1>CareWithJohn Business OS</h1><p>${esc(db.profile.tagline)}. One place for care/support, Home Help & Cleaning, work, money, marketing and your Progressive AI.</p><div class="hero-actions"><button class="btn dark" onclick="quickAdd()">＋ Add</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="showPage('CJ')">✦ Ask CJ</button></div></div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">This week</div><div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Income</div><div class="value">${money(income)}</div><div class="sub">Recorded work</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Net tracked</div><div class="value">${money(net)}</div><div class="sub">After recorded expenses</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">To £1,000</div><div class="value">${money(gap)}</div><div class="sub">Weekly target gap</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Enquiries</div><div class="value">${open}</div><div class="sub">Open</div></div></div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">Next work</div><div class="card"><div class="list">${next.map(jobCard).join('')||'<div class="muted">No upcoming work.</div>'}</div></div>
 <div class="two grid"><div><div class="sectionlabel">Priority actions</div><div class="card"><div class="list"><div class="item"><div><b>${overdue} overdue task${overdue===1?'':'s'}</b><div class="tiny muted">Clear overdue work before creating more admin.</div></div><span class="badge ${overdue?'bad':'good'}">${overdue?'Act':'Clear'}</span></div><div class="item"><div><b>${open} open enquiries</b><div class="tiny muted">Follow up warm leads before buying more reach.</div></div><span class="badge ${open?'warn':'good'}">${open?'Follow':'None'}</span></div><div class="item"><div><b>Home Help & Cleaning</b><div class="tiny muted">${money(db.settings.cleaningRate)}/hour · ${db.settings.cleaningMinimumHours}h minimum.</div></div><span class="badge good">Growth</span></div></div></div></div>
 <div><div class="sectionlabel">Progressive AI</div><div class="card agent"><b>Brain status</b><div class="small muted">Runs: ${db.agent.totalRuns} · Successful: ${db.agent.successfulRuns}</div><div class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:5px">${cycle?`Last cycle ${esc(cycle)}`:'No full learning cycle yet'}</div><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" onclick="runBrainCycle()">Run daily brain cycle</button></div></div></div></div>`;
}
function jobCard(j){return `<div class="item job ${/clean|home/i.test(j.service)?'clean':/move/i.test(j.service)?'move':''}" onclick="openDetail('jobs','${j.id}')"><div><b>${esc(j.date)} · ${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(j.service)} · ${j.hours||0}h</div><div class="tiny muted">${esc(j.location||'')}</div></div><div><b>${money(j.income)}</b><div class="tiny muted">${esc(j.status)}</div></div></div>`}
function projectedJobsForWeek(dstr=selectedDate){
 const start=weekStart(dstr); const out=[];
 const days=['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'];
 for(const r of (db.recurring||[])){
  if(!r.active) continue;
  const idx=days.indexOf(r.day); if(idx<0) continue;
  const d=new Date(start); d.setDate(d.getDate()+idx);
  const date=d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const client=db.clients.find(c=>String(c.name).toLowerCase()===String(r.name).toLowerCase());
  const assigned=r.assignee || (r.name==='Alex' ? '' : 'John');
  const worker=db.team?.find(t=>t.name===assigned);
  const costRate=Number(r.costRate ?? worker?.costRate ?? 0);
  out.push({id:`rec-${r.id}-${date}`,date,time:r.time,name:r.name,clientId:client?.id||'',service:r.service,hours:r.hours,income:r.income,status:assigned?'scheduled':'unassigned',location:r.location||client?.address||'',assignee:assigned,costRate,workerCost:Number((costRate*Number(r.hours||0)).toFixed(2)),source:'Recurring',note:r.note||'',delivery:{}});
 }
 for(const j of db.jobs.filter(j=>inWeek(j.date,dstr))){const worker=db.team?.find(t=>t.name===(j.assignee||j.assignedTo));const costRate=Number(j.costRate ?? worker?.costRate ?? 0);out.push({...j,assignee:j.assignee||j.assignedTo||'',costRate,workerCost:Number(j.workerCost ?? (costRate*Number(j.hours||0)).toFixed(2)),source:'One-off',delivery:j.delivery||{}});}
 return out.sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+b.time));
}
function locationProfile(location=''){
 const x=String(location||'').toLowerCase();
 if(/perth|forgandenny|bridge of earn/.test(x)) return {zone:'Perth',minsFromBase:45};
 if(/stirling/.test(x)) return {zone:'Stirling',minsFromBase:30};
 if(/kinross/.test(x)) return {zone:'Kinross',minsFromBase:35};
 if(/tullibody|alloa|sauchie|clackmannan|local/.test(x)) return {zone:'Local',minsFromBase:10};
 return {zone:'Unknown',minsFromBase:null};
}
function travelMinutes(a,b){
 const A=locationProfile(a),B=locationProfile(b);
 if(A.zone==='Unknown'||B.zone==='Unknown') return null;
 if(A.zone===B.zone) return 10;
 const pair=[A.zone,B.zone].sort().join('|');
 const matrix={'Local|Perth':35,'Local|Stirling':25,'Kinross|Local':35,'Perth|Stirling':35,'Kinross|Perth':35,'Kinross|Stirling':45};
 return matrix[pair] ?? Math.max(A.minsFromBase||20,B.minsFromBase||20);
}
function assignmentRecommendations(target, jobs){
 const people=(db.team||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='Active');
 const sameDay=jobs.filter(x=>x.date===target.date && x.status!=='cancelled' && String(x.id)!==String(target.id));
 return people.map(person=>{
  const mine=sameDay.filter(x=>(x.assignee||x.assignedTo)===person.name).sort((a,b)=>(a.time||'').localeCompare(b.time||''));
  let hard=0, travel=0, nearest=0;
  for(const j of mine){
   const [h,m]=String(j.time||'00:00').split(':').map(Number); const start=h*60+m; const end=start+Number(j.hours||0)*60;
   const [th,tm]=String(target.time||'00:00').split(':').map(Number); const ts=th*60+tm; const tend=ts+Number(target.hours||0)*60;
   const mins=travelMinutes(j.location,target.location);
   if(end<=ts){ const gap=ts-end; if(mins!==null){travel+=Math.max(0,mins-gap); if(gap<mins)hard++;} }
   if(tend<=start){ const gap=start-tend; const mins=travelMinutes(target.location,j.location); if(mins!==null){travel+=Math.max(0,mins-gap); if(gap<mins)hard++;} }
   if((start<=ts&&ts<end)||(ts<=start&&start<tend)) hard++;
  }
  const costRate=Number(target.costRate ?? person.costRate ?? 0);
  const workerCost=costRate*Number(target.hours||0);
  const margin=Number(target.income||0)-workerCost;
  const score=hard?Math.max(0,20-hard*20-travel):Math.max(1,100-travel-Math.max(0,mine.length-2)*5);
  let reason=hard?'Has a scheduling conflict on this visit.':travel?`Travel pressure: about ${Math.round(travel)} extra minutes.`:mine.length?`${mine.length} other visit${mine.length===1?'':'s'} that day; no hard conflict detected.`:'No other visits assigned that day.';
  return {person,score,hard,travel,workerCost,margin,reason};
 }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
}
function bestAssignment(target){
 const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(target.date||selectedDate);
 const recs=assignmentRecommendations(target,jobs);
 return recs.find(x=>x.score>0)||null;
}

function rotaIntelligence(jobs){
 const issues=[];
 const byWorker={};
 jobs.filter(j=>j.assignee&&j.status!=='cancelled').forEach(j=>(byWorker[j.assignee]??=[]).push(j));
 for(const [worker,arr] of Object.entries(byWorker)){
  arr.sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+b.time));
  for(let i=1;i<arr.length;i++){
   const a=arr[i-1],b=arr[i]; if(a.date!==b.date) continue;
   const [ah,am]=String(a.time||'00:00').split(':').map(Number),[bh,bm]=String(b.time||'00:00').split(':').map(Number);
   const end=ah*60+am+Number(a.hours||0)*60, start=bh*60+bm, gap=start-end;
   if(gap<0) issues.push({level:'bad',worker,title:`${worker}: overlapping visits`,text:`${a.name} runs into ${b.name}. Reassign or move the later visit.`,a,b});
   else {const mins=travelMinutes(a.location,b.location); if(mins!==null && gap<mins) issues.push({level:'bad',worker,title:`${worker}: travel gap too short`,text:`${a.name} → ${b.name} needs about ${mins} min travel; only ${Math.max(0,gap)} min is available.`,a,b}); else if(mins!==null && gap<mins+15) issues.push({level:'warn',worker,title:`${worker}: tight travel`,text:`${a.name} → ${b.name} leaves ${gap} min against an estimated ${mins} min journey.`,a,b});}
  }
 }
 const unassigned=jobs.filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled'&&!j.assignee);
 unassigned.forEach(j=>issues.push({level:'warn',title:`Unassigned: ${j.name}`,text:`${j.date} ${j.time} · ${j.service} · ${j.location||'location missing'}. Cover this before the rota is published.`,j}));
 const lowMargin=jobs.filter(j=>Number(j.workerCost||0)>0 && Number(j.income||0)-Number(j.workerCost||0)<Math.max(10,Number(j.income||0)*0.25));
 lowMargin.forEach(j=>issues.push({level:'warn',title:`Low-margin visit: ${j.name}`,text:`${money(Number(j.income||0)-Number(j.workerCost||0))} margin after worker cost. Review price, duration or allocation.`,j}));
 return issues;
}
function rotaScore(jobs){
 const active=jobs.filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled'), issues=rotaIntelligence(active);
 const bad=issues.filter(x=>x.level==='bad').length,warn=issues.filter(x=>x.level==='warn').length;
 return {issues,bad,warn,score:Math.max(0,100-bad*25-warn*8)};
}
function work(c){
 const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate), active=jobs.filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled'), assigned=active.filter(j=>j.assignee), unassigned=active.filter(j=>!j.assignee), completed=active.filter(j=>j.status==='completed').length;
 const days=[...Array(7)].map((_,i)=>{const d=new Date(weekStart(selectedDate));d.setDate(d.getDate()+i);return d.toISOString().slice(0,10)});
 const coverage=Math.round((assigned.length/Math.max(1,active.length))*100), intelligence=rotaScore(active), conflicts=intelligence.issues.filter(x=>x.level==='bad').length, travelFlags=intelligence.issues.filter(x=>/travel/i.test(x.title));
 const personRows=[{name:'John',role:'Owner · 1 active route',jobs:active.filter(j=>j.assignee==='John')},{name:'Unassigned',role:`${unassigned.length} visit${unassigned.length===1?'':'s'} need cover`,jobs:unassigned}];
 c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><div class="smallcaps">Operations</div><h2>Work & Rota</h2><p>One live schedule for John now — built to become the team rota later.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openNew('jobs')">＋ Add work</button></div>
 <div class="work-summary"><div class="work-stat"><div class="smallcaps">Visits</div><div class="big">${active.length}</div><div class="tiny muted">this week</div></div><div class="work-stat ${unassigned.length?'warn':'good'}"><div class="smallcaps">Coverage</div><div class="big">${coverage}%</div><div class="tiny muted">${unassigned.length} unassigned</div></div><div class="work-stat ${conflicts?'danger':'good'}"><div class="smallcaps">Conflicts</div><div class="big">${conflicts}</div><div class="tiny muted">30-min travel buffer</div></div><div class="work-stat"><div class="smallcaps">Scheduled value</div><div class="big">${money(active.reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.income||0),0))}</div><div class="tiny muted">before expenses</div></div></div>
 <div class="card"><div class="work-toolbar"><div class="schedule-tools"><button class="seg ${workMode==='day'?'active':''}" onclick="workMode='day';render()">Day</button><button class="seg ${workMode==='week'?'active':''}" onclick="workMode='week';render()">Week</button><button class="seg ${workMode==='list'?'active':''}" onclick="workMode='list';render()">List</button></div><div class="work-filters"><span class="work-filter active">All work</span><span class="work-filter">Care & Support</span><span class="work-filter">Home Help</span><span class="work-filter">Cleaning</span></div></div><div class="cover-line"><span>Week of ${weekStart(selectedDate).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'short'})}</span><b>${assigned.length}/${active.length} covered</b></div><div class="coverage"><span style="width:${coverage}%"></span></div></div>
 ${workMode==='week'?`<div class="sectionlabel">Team rota</div><div class="rota"><div class="rota-head">Team member</div><div class="rota-dayhead">${days.map(d=>`<div>${new Date(d+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'short'})}<br><span class="muted">${new Date(d+'T12:00:00').getDate()}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>${personRows.map(p=>`<div class="rota-person"><b>${esc(p.name)}</b><span>${esc(p.role)}</span></div><div class="rota-days">${days.map(d=>`<div class="rota-cell">${p.jobs.filter(j=>j.date===d).map(j=>`<div class="visit-chip ${!j.assignee?'unassigned':''} ${/clean|home/i.test(j.service)?'clean':''}" onclick="${String(j.id).startsWith('rec-')?'showPage(\'Work\')':`openDetail('jobs','${j.id}')`}"><div class="vtop">${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.name)}</div><div class="vmeta">${esc(j.service)} · ${j.hours}h</div><div class="vmeta">${esc(j.location||'No location')}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`).join('')}</div>`).join('')}</div>`:
 workMode==='day'?`<div class="sectionlabel">Day view</div><div class="list">${active.filter(j=>j.date===selectedDate).map(j=>`<div class="item job ${!j.assignee?'unassigned':''}"><div><b>${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(j.service)} · ${j.hours}h · ${esc(j.location||'')}</div><div class="tiny muted">Assigned: ${esc(j.assignee||'Needs cover')}</div></div><span class="badge ${j.assignee?'good':'warn'}">${j.assignee?'Covered':'Unassigned'}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No visits for this day.</div>'}</div>`:
 `<div class="sectionlabel">Work list</div><div class="list">${active.map(j=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(j.date)} · ${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(j.service)} · ${j.hours}h · ${esc(j.location||'')}</div></div><span class="badge ${j.assignee?'good':'warn'}">${esc(j.assignee||'Unassigned')}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`}
 <div class="sectionlabel">Rota intelligence</div><div class="card"><div class="item"><div><b>Rota health</b><div class="small muted">Estimated from assigned times, locations, travel and worker cost.</div></div><span class="badge ${intelligence.score>=90?'good':intelligence.score>=70?'warn':'bad'}">${intelligence.score}/100</span></div>${intelligence.issues.slice(0,6).map(x=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(x.title)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(x.text)}</div></div><span class="badge ${x.level==='bad'?'bad':'warn'}">${x.level==='bad'?'Fix':'Review'}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="success" style="margin-top:8px">No route, coverage or margin issues detected.</div>'}</div>
 <div class="work-lower"><div><div class="sectionlabel">Needs attention</div><div class="unallocated">${unassigned.map(j=>{const rec=bestAssignment(j);return `<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(j.service)} · ${esc(j.location||'Location missing')}</div><div class="tiny muted">${j.hours}h · ${money(j.income)}</div>${rec?`<div class="tiny" style="margin-top:4px"><b>Best match: ${esc(rec.person.name)}</b> · ${esc(rec.reason)}</div>`:''}</div><button class="btn" onclick="assignVisit('${j.id}')">${rec?'Assign':'Find cover'}</button></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="card"><b>All visits covered.</b><div class="small muted">No unassigned work this week.</div></div>'}</div></div><div><div class="sectionlabel">Rota checks</div><div class="card"><div class="list"><div class="item"><span>Travel checks</span><b>${travelFlags.length}</b></div><div class="item"><span>Hard conflicts</span><span class="badge ${conflicts?'bad':'good'}">${conflicts||'Clear'}</span></div><div class="item"><span>Recurring visits</span><b>${(db.recurring||[]).filter(x=>x.active).length}</b></div><div class="item"><span>Completed</span><b>${completed}/${active.length}</b></div></div></div>${intelligence.bad?`<div class="notice" style="margin-top:9px"><b>Rota cannot be treated as ready.</b> ${intelligence.bad} hard issue${intelligence.bad===1?'':'s'} need fixing before the rota is published.</div>`:''}</div></div>`;
}

function careHub(c){
 const active=db.clients.filter(x=>x.status!=='Paused');
 const todayJobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(j=>j.date===selectedDate).sort((a,b)=>String(a.time||'').localeCompare(String(b.time||'')));
 const unassigned=todayJobs.filter(j=>!(j.assignee||j.assignedTo));
 const completed=todayJobs.filter(j=>j.status==='completed').length;
 const concerns=(db.concerns||[]).length;
 const next=todayJobs.find(j=>j.status!=='completed')||todayJobs[0];
 const covered=todayJobs.length?Math.round(todayJobs.filter(j=>j.assignee||j.assignedTo).length/todayJobs.length*100):100;
 const dayLabel=new Date(selectedDate+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long'});
 const firstName=(db.profile&&db.profile.name?db.profile.name.split(' ')[0]:'John');
 c.innerHTML=`
 <div class="care-modern-head">
   <div><div class="care-greeting">Good morning, ${esc(firstName)}</div><h2>${esc(dayLabel)}</h2><p>Your care day at a glance.</p></div>
   <div class="care-head-actions"><button class="care-icon-action" onclick="openHandover()" aria-label="Handover">↗</button><button class="care-add" onclick="openNew('clients')">＋ Person</button></div>
 </div>
 <div class="care-statusbar"><div><span class="status-dot"></span><b>${todayJobs.length} visits</b> today</div><div><b>${completed}</b> completed</div><div><b>${covered}%</b> covered</div>${unassigned.length?`<div class="status-alert"><b>${unassigned.length}</b> need cover</div>`:''}</div>
 ${next?`<section class="next-visit-card">
   <div class="next-kicker">NEXT VISIT</div>
   <div class="next-main"><div class="next-avatar">${esc((next.name||'?').split(' ').map(x=>x[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase())}</div><div class="next-person"><div class="next-time">${esc(next.time||'Today')} <span>· ${esc(next.hours||1)} hr</span></div><h3>${esc(next.name)}</h3><p>${esc(next.service||'Care & Support')} · ${esc(next.location||next.address||'Location not recorded')}</p></div><button class="next-arrow" onclick="showPage('Visit Delivery')">›</button></div>
   <div class="next-foot"><span>${esc(next.assignee||next.assignedTo||'Needs cover')}</span><button class="btn primary" onclick="showPage('Visit Delivery')">Open visit</button></div>
 </section>`:`<section class="next-visit-card empty"><div class="next-kicker">TODAY</div><h3>No visits scheduled</h3><p>Your care day is clear.</p></section>`}
 <div class="care-quick"><button onclick="showPage('People')"><span>＋</span> Add person</button><button onclick="showPage('Rota')"><span>▣</span> View rota</button><button onclick="openHandover()"><span>↗</span> Handover</button><button onclick="showPage('Visit Delivery')"><span>✓</span> Record care</button></div>
 <div class="care-modern-grid">
   <section><div class="care-section-head"><div><h3>People you support</h3><p>Tap a person for their care record and recent visits.</p></div><button class="text-link" onclick="showPage('People')">View all</button></div>
     <div class="people-modern">${active.slice(0,6).map((p,i)=>{const pj=todayJobs.filter(j=>j.name===p.name||j.client===p.name);const visit=pj[0];return `<button class="person-modern" onclick="openCareProfile('${p.id}')"><div class="modern-avatar a${i%5}">${esc((p.name||'?').split(' ').map(x=>x[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase())}</div><div class="modern-person-main"><b>${esc(p.name)}</b><span>${esc(p.type||'Care & Support')}</span></div><div class="modern-person-status ${visit?.status==='completed'?'done':visit?'today':''}">${visit?esc(visit.status==='completed'?'Done':visit.time||'Today'):'No visit'}</div><span class="modern-chevron">›</span></button>`}).join('')||'<div class="soft-empty">No active people yet.</div>'}</div>
   </section>
   <section><div class="care-section-head"><div><h3>Team handover</h3><p>Keep the next person informed.</p></div><button class="text-link" onclick="openHandover()">Edit</button></div>
     <div class="handover-modern"><div class="handover-mark">↗</div><div><b>${(db.handover&&db.handover.note)?'Latest update':'No handover yet'}</b><p>${esc((db.handover&&db.handover.note)||'Add a short, factual note about anything the next team member should know.')}</p>${db.handover?.updatedAt?`<span>Updated ${new Date(db.handover.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'numeric',month:'short'})}</span>`:''}</div></div>
   </section>
 </div>
 <section class="today-care-section"><div class="care-section-head"><div><h3>Today’s care</h3><p>Every visit, in one calm view.</p></div><button class="text-link" onclick="showPage('Visit Delivery')">Open delivery</button></div><div class="today-care-list">${todayJobs.slice(0,7).map(j=>`<button class="today-care-row" onclick="showPage('Visit Delivery')"><div class="today-time">${esc(j.time||'—')}</div><div class="today-line"></div><div class="today-info"><b>${esc(j.name)}</b><span>${esc(j.service||'Care & Support')} · ${esc(j.assignee||j.assignedTo||'Unassigned')}</span></div><span class="today-state ${j.status==='completed'?'done':j.assignee||j.assignedTo?'scheduled':'needs'}">${j.status==='completed'?'Done':j.assignee||j.assignedTo?'Scheduled':'Needs cover'}</span><span class="modern-chevron">›</span></button>`).join('')||'<div class="soft-empty">Nothing scheduled today.</div>'}</div></section>
 ${concerns||unassigned.length?`<div class="care-alert-strip"><b>Needs attention</b><span>${unassigned.length?`${unassigned.length} visit${unassigned.length===1?'':'s'} need cover.`:''}${concerns?` ${concerns} concern${concerns===1?'':'s'} recorded.`:''}</span><button onclick="showPage('Visit Delivery')">Review ›</button></div>`:''}`;
}
function personCard(p){ const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(j=>j.name===p.name||j.client===p.name); const last=jobs.find(j=>j.status==='completed')||jobs[0]; return `<button class="person-card" onclick="openCareProfile('${p.id}')"><div class="person-avatar">${esc((p.name||'?').split(' ').map(x=>x[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase())}</div><div class="person-main"><div class="person-name">${esc(p.name)}</div><div class="person-meta">${esc(p.type||'Care & Support')} · ${esc(p.address||'Address not recorded')}</div><div class="person-tags"><span>${jobs.length} scheduled</span><span>${last?.service||'Care plan review'}</span></div></div><span class="arrow">›</span></button>` }

function buildAIContext(){
 const start=weekStart(selectedDate),end=weekEnd(selectedDate);
 const inRange=(d)=>String(d||'')>=start&&String(d||'')<=end;
 const weekJobs=db.jobs.filter(j=>inRange(j.date));
 const weekExpenses=db.expenses.filter(e=>inRange(e.date));
 const income=weekJobs.reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.income||0),0),expenses=weekExpenses.reduce((s,e)=>s+Number(e.amount||0),0);
 return {business:'CareWithJohn',selectedWeek:{start,end},targets:{weekly700:700,weekly1000:1000},income,expenseTotal:expenses,beforeTax:income-expenses,
 clients:db.clients.map(x=>({id:x.id,name:x.name,type:x.type,rate:x.rate,status:x.status,phone:x.phone||''})),
 leads:db.leads.map(x=>({id:x.id,name:x.name,service:x.service,status:x.status,value:x.value||0,source:x.source||'',follow:x.follow||''})),
 jobs:db.jobs.map(x=>({id:x.id,date:x.date,time:x.time,name:x.name,clientId:x.clientId||'',service:x.service,hours:x.hours,income:x.income,status:x.status,location:x.location||'',assignee:x.assignee||x.assignedTo||''})),
 expenses:db.expenses.map(x=>({id:x.id,date:x.date,category:x.category,amount:x.amount,notes:x.notes||''})),
 tasks:db.tasks.map(x=>({id:x.id,title:x.title,due:x.due,priority:x.priority,status:x.status})),
 reviews:db.reviews,marketing:db.marketing,memory:db.memory
 };
}
function toolResult(name,args){
 const a=args||{};
 if(name==='search_clients')return {clients:db.clients.filter(x=>`${x.name} ${x.type}`.toLowerCase().includes(String(a.query||'').toLowerCase()))};
 if(name==='search_leads')return {leads:db.leads.filter(x=>!['won','lost'].includes(x.status)&&`${x.name} ${x.service} ${x.source||''}`.toLowerCase().includes(String(a.query||'').toLowerCase()))};
 if(name==='search_jobs')return {jobs:db.jobs.filter(x=>`${x.name} ${x.service} ${x.date} ${x.status}`.toLowerCase().includes(String(a.query||'').toLowerCase()))};
 if(name==='get_money_summary'){const week=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled'),income=week.reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.income||0),0),expenses=db.expenses.filter(e=>e.date>=weekStart(selectedDate)&&e.date<=weekEnd(selectedDate)).reduce((s,e)=>s+Number(e.amount||0),0);return {income,expenses,beforeTax:income-expenses,target700:Number(db.settings.weekTarget||700),target1000:Number(db.settings.mainTarget||1000),gap1000:Math.max(0,Number(db.settings.mainTarget||1000)-income),weekStart:weekStart(selectedDate),weekEnd:weekEnd(selectedDate)}}
 if(name==='create_task'){const t={id:Date.now()+Math.random(),title:String(a.title||'CJ task'),due:a.due||new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),priority:['low','normal','high','urgent'].includes(a.priority)?a.priority:'normal',status:'open',notes:'Created by CareWithJohn AI'};db.tasks.unshift(t);logActivity('CJ created task',t.title);save();return {created:true,task:t}}
 if(name==='create_client'){if(!String(a.name||'').trim())return {created:false,error:'name_required'};const exists=db.clients.find(x=>x.name.toLowerCase()===String(a.name||'').toLowerCase());if(exists)return {created:false,reason:'client_exists',client:exists};const c={id:Date.now(),name:a.name,type:a.type||'Care & Support',rate:Number(a.rate||(/clean|home help/i.test(a.type||'')?25:30)),status:'Active',phone:a.phone||'',email:a.email||'',address:a.address||'',notes:'Created by CareWithJohn AI'};db.clients.unshift(c);logActivity('CJ created client',c.name);save();return {created:true,client:c}}
 if(name==='create_lead'){if(!String(a.name||'').trim()||!String(a.service||'').trim())return {created:false,error:'name_and_service_required'};const exists=db.leads.find(x=>x.name.toLowerCase()===String(a.name||'').toLowerCase()&&x.status!=='lost');if(exists)return {created:false,reason:'lead_exists',lead:exists};const l={id:Date.now(),name:a.name,service:a.service||'',phone:a.phone||'',status:'new',value:Number(a.value||0),source:a.source||'CJ',follow:a.follow||new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),notes:'Created by CareWithJohn AI'};db.leads.unshift(l);logActivity('CJ created enquiry',l.name);save();return {created:true,lead:l}}
 if(name==='create_job'){if(!String(a.date||'').trim()||!String(a.time||'').trim()||!String(a.name||'').trim()||Number(a.hours||0)<=0)return {created:false,error:'date_time_name_and_positive_hours_required'};const c=a.clientId?db.clients.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(a.clientId)):null;const service=String(a.service||'');const j={id:Date.now(),date:a.date,time:a.time,clientId:a.clientId||'',name:c?c.name:a.name,service,hours:Number(a.hours),income:Number(a.income||0),status:a.status||'planned',location:a.location||'',assignee:a.assignee||a.assignedTo||'',notes:'Created by CareWithJohn AI'};if(!j.income){const rate=c?Number(c.rate||0):0;const serviceRate=/clean|home help/i.test(service)?Number(db.settings.cleaningRate||25):/move/i.test(service)?30:rate;j.income=Number((serviceRate*j.hours).toFixed(2));}const overlap=db.jobs.find(x=>x.date===j.date&&(x.assignee||x.assignedTo)===j.assignee&&j.assignee&&Math.abs((new Date(`${x.date}T${x.time}`)-new Date(`${j.date}T${j.time}`))/3600000)<Math.max(Number(x.hours||1),Number(j.hours||1)));if(overlap)return {created:false,error:'assignment_conflict',conflict:overlap};db.jobs.unshift(j);logActivity('CJ created work',`${j.name} · ${j.date} ${j.time}`);save();const verified=db.jobs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(j.id));return verified?{created:true,verified:true,job:verified}:{created:false,error:'write_verification_failed'} }
 if(name==='complete_task'){const t=db.tasks.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(a.id));if(!t)return {ok:false,error:'task_not_found'};t.status='done';logActivity('CJ completed task',t.title);save();return {completed:true,task:t}}
 if(name==='save_memory'){if(!String(a.title||'').trim()||!String(a.text||'').trim())return {saved:false,error:'title_and_text_required'};const m={id:Date.now(),title:a.title,text:a.text};db.memory.unshift(m);logActivity('CJ saved memory',m.title);save();return {saved:true,memory:m}}
 if(name==='request_approval'){const appr={id:Date.now(),action:a.action,reason:a.reason,status:'pending',created:new Date().toISOString()};db.approvals=db.approvals||[];db.approvals.unshift(appr);logActivity('CJ requested approval',a.action);save();return {approval_required:true,approval:appr}}
 return {ok:false,error:'unknown_tool'}
}
async function runLocalAgent(){
 const prompt=document.getElementById('agentPrompt').value.trim(),out=document.getElementById('agentout');if(!prompt){toast('Tell CJ what you need');return}
 window.__cjBusy=true; out.innerHTML='<b>CJ is working…</b>';  
 try{
   if(!window.CWJOwnAI||typeof window.CWJOwnAI.run!=='function')throw new Error('Progressive AI engine is unavailable. Refresh the app and retry.');
   const result=await window.CWJOwnAI.run(prompt,{context:buildAIContext(),tool:toolResult});
   const runId='own_'+Date.now().toString(36);db.runs=db.runs||[];db.runs.unshift({id:runId,prompt,time:new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB'),result:result.text});logActivity('CJ completed run',result.text);save();
   out.innerHTML=`<b>Done</b><br>${esc(result.text)}${result.actions?.length?`<br><span class="muted">${result.actions.length} business action(s) completed and verified.</span>`:''}`;toast('CJ completed the job');window.__cjBusy=false;
 }catch(e){out.innerHTML=`<b>CJ stopped</b><br>${esc(e.message)}<br><span class="muted">Local-safe mode remains available.</span>`;window.__cjBusy=false;}
}

}

`<div class="item"><span>${st.replace('_',' ')}</span><b>${n}</b></div>`}).join('')}</div></div></div><div><div class="sectionlabel">CJ recommendation</div><div class="card"><b>${overdue?'Clear function brain(c){
 const income=db.jobs.reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.income||0),0);
 const expenses=db.expenses.reduce((s,e)=>s+Number(e.amount||0),0);
 const openLeads=db.leads.filter(x=>!['won','lost','booked'].includes(x.status));
 const overdue=db.tasks.filter(x=>x.status!=='done' && x.due && x.due < new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10));
 const opportunities=[];
 if(openLeads.length) opportunities.push({title:`${openLeads.length} open enquiries`,text:'Fast follow-up protects conversion. Start with the highest-value enquiry first.',go:`showPage('Clients')`});
 if(overdue.length) opportunities.push({title:`${overdue.length} overdue task${overdue.length===1?'':'s'}`,text:'Clear overdue work before adding more low-value admin.',go:`showPage('Work')`});
 if(income < db.settings.mainTarget) opportunities.push({title:`${money(db.settings.mainTarget-income)} to £1,000 target`,text:'Use spare capacity for home help/cleaning lead generation rather than polishing the dashboard.',go:`showPage('Marketing')`});
 const research=[['Care regulation','Verify current Care Inspectorate/SSSC guidance when service scope changes.','High'],['Local pricing','Compare local home-help and cleaning rates and what competitors include.','Medium'],['Lead sources','Measure Facebook, referrals, Instagram and website enquiries by conversion.','Medium'],['Operations','Review travel time and recurring work for margin leaks.','High']];
 const mem=(db.memory||[]).slice(0,6);
 c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>CareWithJohn Brain</h2><p>Business intelligence: facts, patterns, research and next actions.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="runBrainCycle()">Run Brain Cycle</button></div>
 <div class="hero agent"><div class="eyebrow">PROGRESSIVE AI</div><h1 style="color:#fff;margin-top:2px">Think → Check → Learn → Act</h1><p class="muted">Learns from verified outcomes and your corrections. It does not silently rewrite its own code or make unsafe care decisions.</p>
 <div class="grid kpis" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="kpi"><div class="label">Business data</div><div class="value">LIVE</div><div class="sub">Current records</div></div><div class="kpi"><div class="label">Memory</div><div class="value">${mem.length}</div><div class="sub">Facts/rules</div></div><div class="kpi"><div class="label">Open leads</div><div class="value">${openLeads.length}</div><div class="sub">Need attention</div></div><div class="kpi"><div class="label">Research</div><div class="value">${research.length}</div><div class="sub">Watch topics</div></div></div></div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">Business intelligence</div><div class="grid two"><div class="card"><div class="small muted">Revenue recorded</div><div style="font-size:28px;font-weight:950;margin:4px 0">${money(income)}</div><div class="tiny muted">Expenses ${money(expenses)} · Before tax ${money(income-expenses)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="small muted">Gap to £1,000</div><div style="font-size:28px;font-weight:950;margin:4px 0">${money(Math.max(0,db.settings.mainTarget-income))}</div><div class="tiny muted">Target ${money(db.settings.mainTarget)}/week</div></div></div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">Recommended next actions</div><div class="list">${opportunities.slice(0,4).map(o=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(o.title)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(o.text)}</div></div><button class="btn" onclick="${o.go}">Open</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No urgent signals detected.</div>'}</div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">Research watchlist</div><div class="list">${research.map(r=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(r[0])}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(r[1])}</div></div><span class="badge ${r[2]==='High'?'warn':''}">${esc(r[2])}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">Learning memory</div><div class="list">${mem.map(m=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(m.title)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(m.text)}</div>${m.review?`<div class="tiny muted">Status: ${esc(m.review)}</div>`:''}</div><div style="display:flex;gap:5px"><button class="btn" onclick="brainFeedback(${m.id},'helpful')">✓</button><button class="btn" onclick="brainFeedback(${m.id},'wrong')">✕</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No learned rules yet.</div>'}</div>
 <div class="notice" style="margin-top:12px"><b>Research design:</b> when hosted with a secure backend, a scheduled worker can fetch approved sources, compare changes, score confidence, store evidence and surface only material changes. The web research engine is separate from the business action engine.</div>`;
}
function runBrainCycle(){
 const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); const open=db.leads.filter(x=>!['won','lost','booked'].includes(x.status)); const overdue=db.tasks.filter(x=>x.status!=='done'&&x.due&&x.due<today); let created=0;
 if(overdue.length===0&&open.length){const high=[...open].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.value||0)-Number(a.value||0))[0]; if(!db.tasks.some(t=>t.title===`Follow up ${high.name}`&&t.status!=='done')){db.tasks.unshift({id:Date.now(),title:`Follow up ${high.name}`,due:high.follow||today,priority:Number(high.value||0)>=100?'high':'normal',status:'open',notes:'Suggested by CareWithJohn Brain'});created++;}}
 db.runs=db.runs||[];db.runs.unshift({id:'brain_'+Date.now().toString(36),prompt:'Daily Brain Cycle',time:new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB'),result:`Reviewed ${open.length} open enquiries, ${overdue.length} overdue tasks and current target.`});logActivity('Brain cycle completed',created?`Created ${created} follow-up action.`:'No new action required.');save();render();toast(created?'Brain cycle: action created':'Brain cycle: no new action required');
}
function brainFeedback(id,type){db.memory=db.memory||[];const m=db.memory.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!m)return;m.review=type==='wrong'?'Needs review':'Useful';logActivity('Brain feedback',`${type} · ${m.title}`);save();render();toast(type==='wrong'?'Marked for review':'Saved as useful');}
function automations(c){const rules=[{name:'Daily Brain cycle',cadence:'Daily',mode:'Local when app is open',action:'Review enquiries, overdue tasks, target gap and write a learning observation.'},{name:'Lead follow-up',cadence:'On review',mode:'Local',action:'Create missing follow-up tasks without duplicates.'},{name:'Regulatory research',cadence:'Weekly',mode:'Cloud deployment',action:'Fetch approved Care Inspectorate/SSSC sources and store evidence.'},{name:'Market/pricing watch',cadence:'Weekly',mode:'Cloud deployment',action:'Compare approved local competitor pages and flag changes for review.'}];c.innerHTML='<div class="headrow"><div><h2>Automations</h2><p>Background-style rules are explicit, auditable and reversible.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="runBrainCycle()">Run Brain now</button></div><div class="list">'+rules.map(r=>'<div class="item"><div><b>'+esc(r.name)+'</b><div class="small">'+esc(r.action)+'</div><div class="tiny muted">'+esc(r.cadence)+' · '+esc(r.mode)+'</div></div><span class="badge '+(r.mode.includes('Cloud')?'warn':'good')+'">'+(r.mode.includes('Cloud')?'Cloud':'Local')+'</span></div>').join('')+'</div><div class="sectionlabel">What “background” means</div><div class="notice">The local PWA can run its Brain cycle when the app is active. True scheduled research while the phone/app is closed requires the included secure cloud worker and scheduler. This distinction is intentional so the app never pretends a browser timer is a reliable server job.</div>';}
function cleaning(c){const leads=db.leads.filter(x=>/clean|home help/i.test(x.service)&&!['won','lost'].includes(x.status));const jobs=db.jobs.filter(x=>/clean|home help/i.test(x.service));const hours=jobs.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.hours||0),0);const revenue=jobs.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.income||0),0);const wage=hours*13;const gross=revenue-wage;c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>Home Help & Cleaning</h2><p>Manage the service as a business line — enquiries, recurring work, pricing and future delegation.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openNew('leads')">＋ New enquiry</button></div><div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Customer rate</div><div class="value">${money(db.settings.cleaningRate)}</div><div class="sub">Per hour · ${db.settings.cleaningMinimumHours}h minimum</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Recorded hours</div><div class="value">${hours.toFixed(1)}h</div><div class="sub">Current work records</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Revenue</div><div class="value">${money(revenue)}</div><div class="sub">Recorded jobs</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Gross before overhead</div><div class="value">${money(gross)}</div><div class="sub">Using £13/h general wage assumption</div></div></div><div class="two grid"><div><div class="sectionlabel">Service rules</div><div class="card"><div class="list"><div class="item"><span>Home Help / standard cleaning</span><b>£${Number(db.settings.cleaningRate).toFixed(0)}/h</b></div><div class="item"><span>Deep clean starting price</span><b>£100+</b></div><div class="item"><span>General cleaner wage benchmark</span><b>£13/h</b></div><div class="item"><span>Deep-clean wage benchmark</span><b>£16/h</b></div></div></div></div><div><div class="sectionlabel">Delegation readiness</div><div class="card"><b>Build the job around the worker, not around John.</b><div class="small muted" style="margin-top:5px">Before assigning a visit, record the worker, service, customer rate, wage/cost, location, time and required checks.</div><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" onclick="showPage('Team')">Open Team</button> <button class="btn" onclick="showPage('CJ')">Ask CJ</button></div></div></div></div><div class="sectionlabel">Open enquiries</div><div class="list">${leads.map(l=>`<div class="item" onclick="openDetail('leads','${l.id}')"><div><b>${esc(l.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(l.service)} · ${money(l.value||0)} potential</div><div class="tiny muted">${esc(l.source||'Unknown')} · next step ${esc(l.follow||'Not set')}</div></div><span class="badge warn">${esc(l.status)}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No open Home Help/Cleaning enquiries.</div>'}</div>`}
function simple(c,key,label,fields){const canAdd=['reviews','marketing'].includes(key);const rows=db[key].map(r=>`<div class="item" onclick="openDetail('${key}','${r.id}')"><div><b>${esc(r[fields[0]]||r.title||r.client)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(r[fields[1]]||r.channel||'')}</div></div><span class="badge">${esc(r[fields[2]]||r.status||'')}</span></div>`).join('');c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>${label}</h2><p>${db[key].length} item(s).</p></div>${''}</div><div class="list">${rows||'<div class="card muted">Nothing here yet.</div>'}</div>`}
function move(c){c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>MoveWithJohn</h2><p>Movement and wellbeing, kept separate but visible.</p></div></div><div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Last attendance</div><div class="value">3</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Ticket</div><div class="value">£7</div></div></div><div class="sectionlabel">Format</div><div class="card"><b>Seated workout + social time</b><div class="small muted" style="margin-top:4px">Inclusive movement • coffee/snacks • supporters welcome</div></div>`}
function compliance(c){c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>Care Inspectorate</h2><p>Preparation tracker with explicit evidence labels.</p></div><a class="btn" href="https://www.careinspectorate.scot/for-providers/registration/register-a-care-service/registration-guidance" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Official guidance</a></div><div class="list">${(db.compliance||[]).map(x=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(x.area)}</b><div class="small">${esc(x.label)}</div><div class="tiny muted">Source: ${esc(x.source)}</div></div><span class="badge ${x.type==='MUST'?'bad':x.type==='SERVICE-DEPENDENT'?'warn':x.type==='RECOMMENDED'?'good':''}">${esc(x.type)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="sectionlabel">Scope boundary</div><div class="notice">Home Help & Cleaning remains separate from any future regulated personal-care-at-home scope. Verify current official Care Inspectorate and SSSC guidance before changing what the business delivers or advertises.</div>`}
function team(c){const people=db.team||[];const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(x=>x.status!=='cancelled');const assigned=jobs.filter(x=>x.assignee||x.assignedTo);const unassigned=jobs.filter(x=>!(x.assignee||x.assignedTo));const conflicts=[];for(const person of people){const mine=jobs.filter(j=>(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)===person.name).sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+b.time));for(let i=1;i<mine.length;i++){const prev=mine[i-1],cur=mine[i];if(prev.date===cur.date){const p=new Date(`${prev.date}T${prev.time}`),end=new Date(p.getTime()+Number(prev.hours||1)*3600000),st=new Date(`${cur.date}T${cur.time}`);if(st<end)conflicts.push(`${person.name}: ${prev.name} overlaps ${cur.name}`)}}}const coverage=jobs.length?Math.round(assigned.length/jobs.length*100):100;c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>Team</h2><p>People, assignments, capacity and checks — designed for a growing CareWithJohn team.</p></div><span class="badge ${conflicts.length?'bad':'good'}">${conflicts.length?conflicts.length+' conflict(s)':'No time conflicts'}</span></div><div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Active people</div><div class="value">${people.filter(x=>x.status==='Active').length}</div><div class="sub">Available in system</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Unassigned visits</div><div class="value">${unassigned.length}</div><div class="sub">Need an owner</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Coverage</div><div class="value">${coverage}%</div><div class="sub">Upcoming work assigned</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Checks</div><div class="value">${people.filter(x=>x.checks).length}</div><div class="sub">Records present</div></div></div><div class="sectionlabel">People</div><div class="list">${people.map(x=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(x.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(x.role||'Team member')} · ${esc(x.capacity||'')}</div><div class="tiny muted">${esc(x.checks||'No checks recorded')}</div></div><span class="badge ${x.status==='Active'?'good':'warn'}">${esc(x.status)}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No team members recorded.</div>'}</div><div class="sectionlabel">Assignment exceptions</div><div class="list">${unassigned.slice(0,8).map(j=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(j.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(j.date)} ${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.service)}</div><div class="tiny muted">${esc(j.location||'Location missing')}</div></div><span class="badge bad">Unassigned</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="success">All upcoming work has an assignee in the current view.</div>'}</div><div class="sectionlabel">Conflict check</div><div class="card">${conflicts.length?conflicts.map(x=>`<div class="tiny" style="margin-bottom:5px">⚠ ${esc(x)}</div>`).join(''):'<b>No overlapping assignments detected.</b><div class="small muted" style="margin-top:4px">Travel time still needs to be considered between locations.</div>'}</div>`}
function visitDelivery(c){
 const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(x=>x.date===selectedDate).sort((a,b)=>a.time.localeCompare(b.time));
 const done=jobs.filter(x=>x.status==='completed').length,exceptions=jobs.filter(x=>x.status==='exception').length,inProgress=jobs.filter(x=>x.status==='in_progress').length;
 const unassigned=jobs.filter(x=>!(x.assignee||x.assignedTo)).length;
 const revenue=jobs.reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.income||0),0),workerCost=jobs.reduce((s,j)=>s+Number(j.workerCost||0),0),margin=revenue-workerCost;
 const dateMove=(n)=>{const d=new Date(selectedDate+'T12:00:00');d.setDate(d.getDate()+n);selectedDate=d.toISOString().slice(0,10);render()};
 c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><div class="smallcaps">Field operations</div><h2>Visit Delivery</h2><p>Run today's visits from assignment through check-in, completion and exception handling.</p></div><span class="badge ${exceptions?'bad':unassigned?'warn':'good'}">${exceptions?exceptions+' exception(s)':unassigned?unassigned+' unassigned':'Ready'}</span></div>
 <div class="card"><div class="delivery-tools"><button class="btn" onclick="dateMove(-1)">← Previous</button><input class="delivery-date" type="date" value="${esc(selectedDate)}" onchange="selectedDate=this.value;render()"><button class="btn" onclick="dateMove(1)">Next →</button><button class="btn" onclick="selectedDate=todayISO();render()">Today</button></div></div>
 <div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Visits</div><div class="value">${jobs.length}</div><div class="sub">Scheduled</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Delivery</div><div class="value">${done}/${jobs.length}</div><div class="sub">${inProgress} in progress</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Revenue</div><div class="value">${money(revenue)}</div><div class="sub">Today's work</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Job margin</div><div class="value ${margin<0?'margin-warn':'margin-good'}">${money(margin)}</div><div class="sub">After worker cost</div></div></div>
 <div class="sectionlabel">${new Date(selectedDate+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long'})}</div>
 <div class="list">${jobs.map(j=>deliveryCard(j)).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No visits scheduled for this date.</div>'}</div>
 <div class="notice" style="margin-top:12px"><b>Delivery rule:</b> a visit is not finished until the assigned worker, check-in/out timestamps, delivery status and any exception are recorded. Sensitive care information remains outside this general business delivery log.</div>`;
}
function deliveryCard(j){
 const d=j.delivery||{}, assigned=j.assignee||j.assignedTo||'', status=j.status||'scheduled';
 const cost=Number(j.workerCost||0), margin=Number(j.income||0)-cost;
 const statusLabel={scheduled:'Scheduled',in_progress:'In progress',completed:'Completed',exception:'Exception',planned:'Planned'}[status]||status;
 const badge=status==='completed'?'good':status==='exception'?'bad':status==='in_progress'?'warn':assigned?'':'warn';
 return `<div class="delivery-card ${status==='in_progress'?'active':''}"><div class="delivery-top"><div><b>${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.name)}</b><div class="small">${esc(j.service)} · ${Number(j.hours||0)}h · ${esc(j.location||'Location missing')}</div><div class="tiny muted">Assigned: ${esc(assigned||'Needs cover')}</div></div><span class="badge ${badge}">${esc(statusLabel)}</span></div>
 <div class="delivery-meta"><div class="mini"><span>Customer</span><b>${money(j.income)}</b></div><div class="mini"><span>Worker cost</span><b>${money(cost)}</b></div><div class="mini"><span>Margin</span><b class="${margin<0?'margin-warn':'margin-good'}">${money(margin)}</b></div>${d.checkIn?`<div class="mini"><span>Checked in</span><b>${formatTime(d.checkIn)}</b></div>`:''}${d.checkOut?`<div class="mini"><span>Checked out</span><b>${formatTime(d.checkOut)}</b></div>`:''}<div class="mini"><span>Delivery note</span><b>${esc(d.note||j.notes||'None')}</b></div></div>
 <div class="delivery-actions">${!assigned?`<button class="btn warn" onclick="assignVisit('${j.id}')">Assign</button>`:''}${status!=='in_progress'&&status!=='completed'?`<button class="btn" onclick="visitAction('${j.id}','checkin')">Check in</button>`:''}${status==='in_progress'?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="openVisitNote('${j.id}','complete')">Complete</button>`:''}${status!=='completed'?`<button class="btn danger" onclick="openVisitNote('${j.id}','exception')">Exception</button>`:''}<button class="btn" onclick="openVisitNote('${j.id}','note')">Note</button><button class="btn" onclick="openDetail('jobs','${j.id}')">Edit</button></div></div>`;
}
function formatTime(iso){try{return new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}catch{return '—'}}
function assignVisit(id){let j=db.jobs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!j){const projected=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(projected){j={...projected,id:'v_'+Date.now(),status:'scheduled',source:'Materialised from recurring rota',recurringId:projected.id};db.jobs.unshift(j)}}if(!j){toast('Visit not found');return}const people=(db.team||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='Active');const recs=assignmentRecommendations(j,projectedJobsForWeek(j.date)); const best=recs[0];document.getElementById('drawerTitle').textContent='Assign visit';document.getElementById('drawerBody').innerHTML=`<div class="small muted">${esc(j.name)} · ${esc(j.date)} ${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.service)}</div>${best?`<div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px"><b>Recommended: ${esc(best.person.name)}</b><div class="small" style="margin-top:3px">${esc(best.reason)} ${best.margin>=0?`Projected margin ${money(best.margin)}.`:'This allocation would not cover worker cost.'}</div></div>`:`<div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px"><b>No active worker available.</b><div class="small">Add a team member before assigning delegated work.</div></div>`}<div class="formgrid" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="field"><label>Assigned worker</label><select id="assign-worker"><option value="">Select worker</option>${people.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p.name)}" ${best&&best.person.name===p.name?'selected':''}>${esc(p.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Worker cost £/hour</label><input id="assign-cost" type="number" step="0.01" value="${Number((best&&best.person.costRate)||j.costRate||0)}"></div></div><button class="btn primary" style="width:100%;margin-top:14px" onclick="saveAssignment('${j.id}')">Save assignment</button>`;openDrawer()}
function saveAssignment(id){if(!requireAdminOwner('visit.assign'))return;let j=db.jobs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!j){toast('Visit not found');return}const worker=document.getElementById('assign-worker').value,costRate=Number(document.getElementById('assign-cost').value||0);if(!worker){toast('Choose a worker');return}const conflict=db.jobs.find(x=>x.id!==j.id&&x.date===j.date&&(x.assignee||x.assignedTo)===worker&&x.time&&Math.abs((new Date(`${x.date}T${x.time}`)-new Date(`${j.date}T${j.time}`))/3600000)<Math.max(Number(x.hours||1),Number(j.hours||1)));if(conflict){toast(`Conflict with ${conflict.name}`);return}j.assignee=worker;j.costRate=costRate;j.workerCost=Number((costRate*Number(j.hours||0)).toFixed(2));logActivity('Visit assigned',`${j.name} → ${worker}`);save();closeDrawer();render();toast('Visit assigned')}
function openVisitNote(id,action){let j=db.jobs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!j){const projected=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(projected){j={...projected,id:'v_'+Date.now(),status:'scheduled',source:'Materialised from recurring rota',recurringId:projected.id};db.jobs.unshift(j)}}if(!j){toast('Visit not found');return}document.getElementById('drawerTitle').textContent=action==='complete'?'Complete visit':action==='exception'?'Record exception':'Visit note';document.getElementById('drawerBody').innerHTML=`<div class="small muted">${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.name)} · ${esc(j.service)}</div><div class="field" style="margin-top:12px"><label>${action==='exception'?'Exception reason':'Delivery note'}</label><textarea id="visit-note" style="min-height:110px" placeholder="Record what happened on this visit…">${esc(j.delivery?.note||'')}</textarea></div>${action==='exception'?`<div class="field" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Follow-up required?</label><select id="visit-follow"><option value="No">No</option><option value="Yes">Yes</option></select></div>`:''}<button class="btn ${action==='exception'?'danger':'primary'}" style="width:100%;margin-top:12px" onclick="saveVisitNote('${j.id}','${action}')">${action==='complete'?'Complete visit':action==='exception'?'Record exception':'Save note'}</button>`;openDrawer()}
function saveVisitNote(id,action){if(!requireAdminOwner('visit.delivery'))return;const j=db.jobs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!j)return;const note=document.getElementById('visit-note')?.value||'';j.delivery=j.delivery||{};j.delivery.note=note;if(action==='complete'){if(!j.delivery.checkIn)j.delivery.checkIn=new Date().toISOString();j.delivery.checkOut=new Date().toISOString();j.delivery.durationHours=Number(j.hours||0);j.status='completed'}else if(action==='exception'){j.status='exception';j.delivery.exceptionAt=new Date().toISOString();j.delivery.followUp=document.getElementById('visit-follow')?.value||'No'}else{j.status=j.status==='scheduled'?'in_progress':j.status}logActivity('Visit delivery updated',`${j.name} · ${action}`);save();closeDrawer();render();toast(action==='complete'?'Visit completed':action==='exception'?'Exception recorded':'Note saved')}
function visitAction(id,action){let j=db.jobs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!j){const projected=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(projected){j={...projected,id:'v_'+Date.now(),status:'scheduled',source:'Materialised from recurring rota',recurringId:projected.id};db.jobs.unshift(j)}}if(!j){toast('Visit not found');return}j.status=action==='complete'?'completed':action==='exception'?'exception':'in_progress';j.delivery=j.delivery||{};if(action==='checkin')j.delivery.checkIn=new Date().toISOString();if(action==='complete'){j.delivery.checkOut=new Date().toISOString();j.delivery.durationHours=Number(j.hours||0)}if(action==='exception')j.delivery.exceptionAt=new Date().toISOString();logActivity('Visit updated',`${j.name} · ${action}`);save();render();toast(action==='complete'?'Visit completed':action==='exception'?'Exception recorded':'Checked in')}
function documents(c){c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>Documents</h2><p>Business files, policies and useful documents in one place.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="pickDocument()">＋ Add file</button></div><div class="notice">Files in this preview are stored on this device with IndexedDB, which is designed for structured data and file/blob storage. Cloud documents come with the live backend.</div><div class="sectionlabel">Files</div><div class="list">${db.documents.map(d=>`<div class="item"><div><b>${esc(d.name)}</b><div class="tiny muted">${esc(d.type)} · ${esc(d.size)}</div></div><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><button class="btn" onclick="downloadDocument(${d.id})">Open</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="removeDocument(${d.id})">Delete</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No files yet.</div>'}</div>`}
function field(f){const labels={name:'Name',type:'Service type',status:'Status',rate:'Hourly rate',service:'Service',phone:'Phone',email:'Email',address:'Address',value:'Potential value',source:'Source',follow:'Follow-up',date:'Date',time:'Time',hours:'Hours',income:'Income',location:'Location',category:'Category',amount:'Amount',number:'Number',client:'Client',validUntil:'Valid until',due:'Due date',assignee:'Assigned to',notes:'Notes'};const opts={type:['Care & Support','Home Help & Cleaning','MoveWithJohn'],service:['Care & Support','Home Help','Cleaning','MoveWithJohn'],status:['Active','Paused','new','contacted','quoted','follow_up','booked','planned','scheduled','in_progress','completed','exception','Draft','Sent','Accepted','Declined','Paid','Overdue'],source:['Facebook','Referral','Website','Instagram','Other'],assignee:(db.team||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='Active').map(x=>x.name)}[f];const typ=['rate','value','hours','income','amount'].includes(f)?'number':['date','follow','validUntil','due'].includes(f)?'date':f==='phone'?'tel':f==='email'?'email':'text';return `<div class="field"><label>${labels[f]||f}</label>${opts?`<select id="f-${f}"><option value="">${f==='assignee'?'Unassigned':'Select'}</option>${opts.map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select>`:`<input id="f-${f}" type="${typ}">`}</div>`}

 const fields={clients:['name','type','status','rate','phone','email','address'],leads:['name','service','phone','status','value','source','follow'],jobs:['date','time','name','service','hours','income','status','location','assignee','notes'],expenses:['date','category','amount'],quotes:['number','client','service','value','status','date','validUntil'],invoices:['number','client','amount','status','date','due']}[key];if(!fields){toast('Use the relevant section to add this item');return}

 const fields={clients:['name','type','status','rate','phone','email','address'],leads:['name','service','phone','status','value','source','follow'],jobs:['date','time','name','service','hours','income','status','location','assignee','notes'],expenses:['date','category','amount'],quotes:['number','client','service','value','status','date','validUntil'],invoices:['number','client','amount','status','date','due']}[key],r={id:Date.now()};fields.forEach(f=>{const e=document.getElementById('f-'+f);r[f]=e?e.value:''});['rate','value','hours','income','amount'].forEach(f=>{if(r[f]!=='')r[f]=Number(r[f])});if(key==='jobs'){r.clientId='';const worker=db.team?.find(t=>t.name===r.assignee);r.costRate=Number(worker?.costRate||0);r.workerCost=Number((r.costRate*Number(r.hours||0)).toFixed(2));r.delivery={}}if(key==='clients'){r.notes=''}if(key==='leads'){r.notes=''}if(key==='expenses'){r.notes=''}if(key==='quotes'){r.notes=''}if(key==='invoices'){r.notes=''}db[key].unshift(r);db.activity.unshift({id:Date.now()+1,title:`Added ${key.slice(0,-1)}`,detail:r.name||r.category||'New record',time:new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB')});save();closeDrawer();render();toast('Saved')}
function openDetail(key,id){
 const r=db[key]?.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!r)return;
 const editable=['clients','leads','jobs','expenses','quotes','invoices'].includes(key);
 const fields=key==='clients'?['name','type','status','rate','phone','email','address','notes']:key==='leads'?['name','service','status','value','source','follow','phone','notes']:key==='jobs'?['date','time','name','service','hours','income','status','location','assignee','notes']:key==='quotes'?['number','client','service','value','status','date','validUntil']:key==='invoices'?['number','client','amount','status','date','due']:['date','category','amount','notes'];
 document.getElementById('drawerTitle').textContent=editable?'Edit record':'Details';
 if(!editable){document.getElementById('drawerBody').innerHTML=`<div class="list">${Object.entries(r).filter(([k])=>k!=='id').map(([k,v])=>`<div class="item"><span class="muted">${esc(k)}</span><b>${esc(v)}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`;openDrawer();return}
 const html=fields.map(f=>{let h=field(f).replace(`id="f-${f}"`,`id="e-${f}"`);const val=r[f]??'';h=h.replace(`type="date">`,`type="date" value="${esc(val)}">`).replace(`type="number">`,`type="number" value="${esc(val)}">`).replace(`type="text">`,`type="text" value="${esc(val)}">`).replace(`type="tel">`,`type="tel" value="${esc(val)}">`).replace(`type="email">`,`type="email" value="${esc(val)}">`);h=h.replace(`><select`, `><select`);if(h.includes('<select'))h=h.replace(`value="${esc(val)}"`,``).replace(`<select id="e-${f}">`,`<select id="e-${f}"><option value="">${f==='assignee'?'Unassigned':'Select'}</option>`).replace(`<option>${esc(val)}</option>`,`<option selected>${esc(val)}</option>`);return h}).join('');
 document.getElementById('drawerBody').innerHTML=`<div class="formgrid">${html}</div><div style="margin-top:14px;display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn primary" style="flex:1" onclick="saveEdit('${key}','${r.id}')">Save changes</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="deleteRecord('${key}','${r.id}')">Delete</button></div>`;openDrawer();
}

function settings(c){c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><h2>Settings</h2><p>Business controls, targets, backup and cloud-ready configuration.</p></div></div><div class="two grid"><div class="card"><div class="sectionlabel" style="margin-top:0">Targets & prices</div><div class="formgrid"><div class="field"><label>Weekly baseline target</label><input id="s-week" type="number" value="${db.settings.weekTarget}"></div><div class="field"><label>Weekly main target</label><input id="s-main" type="number" value="${db.settings.mainTarget}"></div><div class="field"><label>Home Help & Cleaning £/hour</label><input id="s-clean" type="number" value="${db.settings.cleaningRate}" step="0.01"></div><div class="field"><label>Cleaning minimum hours</label><input id="s-min" type="number" value="${db.settings.cleaningMinimumHours}" step="0.5"></div></div><button class="btn primary" style="margin-top:10px;width:100%" onclick="saveSettings()">Save settings</button></div><div class="card"><div class="sectionlabel" style="margin-top:0">Data safety</div><div class="quickgrid"><button class="quick" onclick="exportData()"><b>Export backup</b><span>Download JSON copy</span></button><button class="quick" onclick="importData()"><b>Import backup</b><span>Restore previously exported data</span></button><button class="quick" onclick="downloadCSV('clients')"><b>Clients CSV</b><span>Simple export</span></button><button class="quick" onclick="downloadCSV('jobs')"><b>Jobs CSV</b><span>Simple export</span></button></div><div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px">Production mode is active. Protected application data requires a valid Supabase session and active organisation membership.</div></div></div><div class="sectionlabel">Cloud access</div><div class="card"><div class="item" style="padding:0;border:0"><div><b>Secure business sync</b><div class="small muted">${cloudUser?esc(cloudUser.email):'Not connected'} · ${cloudUser?esc(cloudUser.role):'offline/local'}</div></div><button class="btn ${cloudUser?'danger':'primary'}" onclick="cloudAccess()">${cloudUser?'Sign out':'Sign in'}</button></div><div class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:9px">Cloud access is required in production. Changes are versioned and audited on the server.</div></div><div class="sectionlabel">Application health</div><div class="card"><div class="list"><div class="item"><span>Schema</span><b>v${SCHEMA_VERSION}</b></div><div class="item"><span>AI engine</span><b>${esc(window.CWJOwnAI?.version||'loading')}</b></div><div class="item"><span>Service worker</span><b>${'serviceWorker' in navigator?'Supported':'Unavailable'}</b></div><div class="item"><span>Local database</span><b>IndexedDB + localStorage</b></div></div></div>`}
function saveSettings(){if(!requireAdminOwner('settings.update'))return;db.settings.weekTarget=Number(document.getElementById('s-week').value||700);db.settings.mainTarget=Number(document.getElementById('s-main').value||1000);db.settings.cleaningRate=Number(document.getElementById('s-clean').value||25);db.settings.cleaningMinimumHours=Number(document.getElementById('s-min').value||1);logActivity('Settings updated','Targets/prices changed');save();render();toast('Settings saved')}
function downloadCSV(key){const rows=db[key]||[],cols=[...new Set(rows.flatMap(r=>Object.keys(r)))];const csv=[cols.join(','),...rows.map(r=>cols.map(c=>'"'+String(r[c]??'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(','))].join('\n');const a=document.createElement('a');a.href='data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(csv);a.download=`carewithjohn-${key}.csv`;a.click()}
function importData(){const i=document.createElement('input');i.type='file';i.accept='.json,application/json';i.onchange=()=>{const f=i.files[0];if(!f)return;const rd=new FileReader();rd.onload=()=>{try{db=merge(JSON.parse(rd.result));save();render();toast('Backup imported')}catch{toast('Invalid backup file')}};rd.readAsText(f)};i.click()}
function fieldValue(f,v,key){return field(f).replace(new RegExp('id=\"f-'+f+'\"'),'id=\"e-'+f+'\"')}
function saveEdit(key,id){if(!requireAdminOwner('record.update'))return;const r=db[key]?.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!r)return;const fields=key==='clients'?['name','type','status','rate','phone','email','address','notes']:key==='leads'?['name','service','status','value','source','follow','phone','notes']:key==='jobs'?['date','time','name','service','hours','income','status','location','assignee','notes']:key==='quotes'?['number','client','service','value','status','date','validUntil']:key==='invoices'?['number','client','amount','status','due','date']:['date','category','amount','notes'];for(const f of fields){const e=document.getElementById('e-'+f);if(!e)continue;r[f]=['rate','value','hours','income','amount'].includes(f)?Number(e.value||0):e.value}logActivity('Updated record',`${key}: ${r.name||r.category||r.title||id}`);save();closeDrawer();render();toast('Changes saved')}
function deleteRecord(key,id){if(!requireAdminOwner('record.delete'))return;db[key]=db[key].filter(x=>String(x.id)!==String(id));logActivity('Deleted record',`${key}: ${id}`);save();closeDrawer();render();toast('Deleted')}

function closeDrawer(){document.getElementById('drawer').classList.remove('open');document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('open')}
