function openSearch(q){document.getElementById('command').classList.add('open');document.getElementById('commandInput').value=q;renderCommand(q)}
function closeSearch(){document.getElementById('command').classList.remove('open')}
function renderCommand(q){q=(q||'').toLowerCase();const pages=[...MAIN,...MORE].map(p=>({kind:'Page',name:p,detail:'Open',go:()=>{showPage(p);closeSearch()}}));const rec=[...db.clients.map(x=>({kind:'Client',name:x.name,detail:x.type,page:'Clients',key:'clients',id:x.id})),...db.leads.map(x=>({kind:'Enquiry',name:x.name,detail:x.service,page:'Clients',key:'leads',id:x.id})),...db.jobs.map(x=>({kind:'Work',name:x.name,detail:x.service,page:'Work',key:'jobs',id:x.id}))].filter(x=>`${x.name} ${x.detail}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0,10);const all=[...pages.filter(x=>!q||x.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)),...rec];window._cmd=all;document.getElementById('commandList').innerHTML=all.slice(0,18).map((x,i)=>`<div class="commanditem" onclick="${x.go?`window._cmd[${i}].go()`: `closeSearch();showPage('${x.page}');setTimeout(()=>openDetail('${x.key}','${x.id}'),70)`}"><div><b>${esc(x.name)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(x.detail)}</div></div><span class="badge">${x.kind}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="muted" style="padding:14px">No matches.</div>'}
function pickDocument(){const i=document.createElement('input');i.type='file';i.onchange=()=>{const f=i.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{db.documents.unshift({id:Date.now(),name:f.name,type:f.type||'file',size:formatBytes(f.size),data:r.result});save();render();toast('Document saved locally')};r.readAsDataURL(f)};i.click()}
function formatBytes(n){if(n<1024)return n+' B';if(n<1048576)return Math.round(n/1024)+' KB';return (n/1048576).toFixed(1)+' MB'}
function downloadDocument(id){const d=db.documents.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!d)return;const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=d.data;a.download=d.name;a.click()}
function exportData(){const clean={...db,documents:db.documents.map(d=>({...d,data:undefined}))};const a=document.createElement('a');a.href='data:application/json;charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(clean,null,2));a.download='carewithjohn-backup.json';a.click();toast('Backup exported')}
function resetData(){toast('Demo reset is disabled in production.');}
function dayKey(d){return ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][new Date(d+'T12:00:00').getDay()]}
function minsOf(t){const [h,m]=String(t||'00:00').split(':').map(Number);return h*60+(m||0)}
function personAvailable(person,date,time,hours){
  const a=person.availability?.[dayKey(date)]; if(!a) return false;
  const st=minsOf(time), en=st+Number(hours||1)*60;
  return st>=minsOf(a[0]) && en<=minsOf(a[1]);
}
function workerDayJobs(person,date,jobs,targetId){return jobs.filter(j=>j.date===date&&String(j.id)!==String(targetId)&&(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)===person.name&&j.status!=='cancelled')}
function plannerRecommendation(target,jobs){
  ensurePlanningDefaults();
  const people=(db.team||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='Active');
  return people.map(person=>{
    const mine=workerDayJobs(person,target.date,jobs,target.id).sort((a,b)=>minsOf(a.time)-minsOf(b.time));
    let hard=0,travel=0,availability=personAvailable(person,target.date,target.time,target.hours);
    if(!availability) hard++;
    const zoneSet=String(person.zones||'').toLowerCase().split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const locZone=locationProfile(target.location).zone.toLowerCase();
    if(zoneSet.length && !zoneSet.some(z=>locZone.includes(z)||z.includes(locZone))) hard++;
    for(const j of mine){
      const js=minsOf(j.time), je=js+Number(j.hours||1)*60, ts=minsOf(target.time), te=ts+Number(target.hours||1)*60;
      if(!(te<=js||ts>=je)){hard++;continue}
      if(te<=js){const gap=js-te,need=travelMinutes(target.location,j.location);if(need!=null){travel+=need; if(gap<need)hard++;}}
      if(je<=ts){const gap=ts-je,need=travelMinutes(j.location,target.location);if(need!=null){travel+=need; if(gap<need)hard++;}}
    }
    const dayHours=mine.reduce((a,j)=>a+Number(j.hours||0),0)+Number(target.hours||0);
    if(dayHours>Number(person.maxHours||60)/5*1.5) hard++;
    const costRate=Number(person.costRate||target.costRate||0), workerCost=costRate*Number(target.hours||0), margin=Number(target.income||0)-workerCost;
    let score=100-hard*35-Math.min(30,travel*.35)-Math.max(0,mine.length-2)*5;
    if(margin<0) score-=20;
    const reason=hard?(!availability?'Outside availability':zoneSet.length&&!zoneSet.some(z=>locZone.includes(z)||z.includes(locZone))?'Outside preferred area':`Has ${hard} planning conflict${hard>1?'s':''}`):travel?`Fits availability; about ${Math.round(travel)} min travel pressure`:mine.length?`Fits around ${mine.length} other visit${mine.length===1?'':'s'}`:'Free that day';
    return {person,score,hard,travel,workerCost,margin,reason,dayHours};
  }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
}
function autoPlanWeek(date){
  ensurePlanningDefaults();
  const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(date).filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled');
  let assigned=0, skipped=0;
  const targets=jobs.filter(j=>!(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)).sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+b.time));
  for(const target of targets){
    const recs=plannerRecommendation(target,jobs); const best=recs.find(x=>x.hard===0&&x.score>=55);
    if(!best){skipped++;continue}
    let live=db.jobs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(target.id));
    if(!live && String(target.id).startsWith('rec-')){live={...target,id:'v_'+Date.now()+assigned,source:'Auto-planned from recurring rota',recurringId:target.id};db.jobs.unshift(live);}
    if(!live) continue;
    live.assignee=best.person.name;live.costRate=Number(best.person.costRate||0);live.workerCost=Number((live.costRate*Number(live.hours||0)).toFixed(2));live.delivery=live.delivery||{};assigned++;
  }
  if(assigned) logActivity('CJ planning run',`${assigned} safe visit${assigned===1?'':'s'} assigned; ${skipped} left for review`);
  save();render();toast(assigned?`Auto-planned ${assigned} visit${assigned===1?'':'s'}${skipped?` · ${skipped} need review`:''}`:'No safe automatic assignments found');
}
function planning(c){
  ensurePlanningDefaults();
  const jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled');
  const unassigned=jobs.filter(j=>!(j.assignee||j.assignedTo));
  const people=(db.team||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='Active');
  const dayHours=p=>jobs.filter(j=>(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)===p.name).reduce((a,j)=>a+Number(j.hours||0),0);
  const recRows=unassigned.slice(0,12).map(j=>{const rec=plannerRecommendation(j,jobs)[0];return {j,rec}});
  const safe=recRows.filter(x=>x.rec&&x.rec.hard===0&&x.rec.score>=55).length;
  const risk=recRows.filter(x=>!x.rec||x.rec.hard>0).length;
  c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><div class="smallcaps">Operations engine</div><h2>Planning & Capacity</h2><p>Availability, workload, travel and margin in one decision layer.</p></div><div style="display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn" onclick="showPage('Team')">Team settings</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="autoPlanWeek(selectedDate)">✦ Auto-plan safe work</button></div></div>
  <div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Unassigned</div><div class="value">${unassigned.length}</div><div class="sub">Need a decision</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Safe to assign</div><div class="value">${safe}</div><div class="sub">No hard conflict</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Needs review</div><div class="value">${risk}</div><div class="sub">Availability/travel issue</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Active team</div><div class="value">${people.length}</div><div class="sub">Capacity profiles</div></div></div>
  <div class="two grid"><div><div class="sectionlabel">Capacity this week</div><div class="list">${people.map(p=>{const h=dayHours(p),cap=Number(p.maxHours||60),pct=Math.min(100,Math.round(h/cap*100));return `<div class="card plan-person"><div class="item" style="border:0;padding:0"><div><b>${esc(p.name)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(p.role||'Team member')} · ${esc(p.zones||'No areas set')}</div></div><span class="badge ${pct>100?'bad':pct>85?'warn':'good'}">${h.toFixed(1)}h / ${cap}h</span></div><div class="coverage" style="margin-top:9px"><span style="width:${pct}%"></span></div><div class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:6px">Services: ${esc(p.services||'Not set')}</div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="card muted">Add active team members to enable delegated planning.</div>'}</div></div>
  <div><div class="sectionlabel">Unassigned work</div><div class="list">${recRows.map(({j,rec})=>`<div class="card plan-item"><div class="item" style="border:0;padding:0"><div><b>${esc(j.name)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(j.date)} · ${esc(j.time)} · ${esc(j.service)}</div><div class="tiny muted">${esc(j.location||'Location missing')} · ${Number(j.hours||0)}h · ${money(j.income||0)}</div></div><span class="badge ${rec&&rec.hard===0&&rec.score>=55?'good':rec?'warn':'bad'}">${rec?esc(rec.person.name):'No fit'}</span></div>${rec?`<div class="tiny" style="margin-top:8px">${esc(rec.reason)} · score ${Math.round(rec.score)}${rec.margin>=0?` · margin ${money(rec.margin)}`:''}</div><button class="btn" style="margin-top:8px;width:100%" onclick="assignVisit('${j.id}')">Review assignment</button>`:'<div class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:8px">No active team member can safely take this visit.</div>'}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="success">All current work has an assignee.</div>'}</div></div></div>
  <div class="sectionlabel">Planning rules</div><div class="card"><div class="rulegrid"><div><b>Hard stop</b><span>Never auto-assign through a time conflict or outside stated availability.</span></div><div><b>Travel</b><span>Uses CareWithJohn zone estimates between consecutive visits.</span></div><div><b>Capacity</b><span>Checks weekly workload against each worker’s maximum hours.</span></div><div><b>Margin</b><span>Worker cost is included before recommending delegated work.</span></div></div></div>`;
}


function openTeamEditor(id){
 ensurePlanningDefaults();
 const isNew=!id, t=isNew?{id:'tm_'+Date.now(),name:'',role:'',status:'Active',costRate:13,maxHours:40,zones:'Local',services:'Care & Support, Home Help, Cleaning'}:(db.team||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));
 if(!t)return;
 const days=['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'];
 document.getElementById('drawerTitle').textContent=isNew?'Add team member':'Edit team member';
 document.getElementById('drawerBody').innerHTML=`<div class="formgrid"><div class="field"><label>Name</label><input id="tm-name" value="${esc(t.name||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>Role</label><input id="tm-role" value="${esc(t.role||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>Status</label><select id="tm-status"><option ${t.status==='Active'?'selected':''}>Active</option><option ${t.status==='Paused'?'selected':''}>Paused</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Worker cost £/hour</label><input id="tm-cost" type="number" step="0.01" value="${Number(t.costRate||0)}"></div><div class="field"><label>Maximum weekly hours</label><input id="tm-max" type="number" step="0.5" value="${Number(t.maxHours||40)}"></div><div class="field"><label>Preferred areas / zones</label><input id="tm-zones" value="${esc(t.zones||'Local')}"></div><div class="field" style="grid-column:1/-1"><label>Services they can deliver</label><input id="tm-services" value="${esc(t.services||'Care & Support, Home Help, Cleaning')}"></div></div><div class="sectionlabel">Availability</div><div class="list">${days.map(d=>{const a=t.availability?.[d]||['06:00','22:00'];return `<div class="item"><b>${d}</b><div style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input id="tm-${d}-from" type="time" value="${a[0]}"><input id="tm-${d}-to" type="time" value="${a[1]}"></div></div>`}).join('')}</div><button class="btn primary" style="width:100%;margin-top:12px" onclick="saveTeamEditor('${t.id}',${isNew})">Save team member</button>${isNew?'':`<button class="btn danger" style="width:100%;margin-top:7px" onclick="deleteTeamMember('${t.id}')">Remove team member</button>`}`;
 openDrawer();
}
function saveTeamEditor(id,isNew){
 const t=isNew?{id}:{...(db.team||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id))};
 if(!t)return;
 t.name=document.getElementById('tm-name').value.trim(); if(!t.name){toast('Name is required');return}
 t.role=document.getElementById('tm-role').value.trim()||'Team member';t.status=document.getElementById('tm-status').value;t.costRate=Number(document.getElementById('tm-cost').value||0);t.maxHours=Number(document.getElementById('tm-max').value||40);t.zones=document.getElementById('tm-zones').value.trim();t.services=document.getElementById('tm-services').value.trim();t.availability={};for(const d of ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'])t.availability[d]=[document.getElementById(`tm-${d}-from`).value||'06:00',document.getElementById(`tm-${d}-to`).value||'22:00'];
 if(isNew)db.team.unshift(t);logActivity(isNew?'Team member added':'Team member updated',t.name);save();closeDrawer();render();toast(isNew?'Team member added':'Team member saved');
}
function deleteTeamMember(id){const t=(db.team||[]).find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(!t)return;if(db.jobs.some(j=>(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)===t.name)){toast('Reassign their visits before removing them');return}db.team=db.team.filter(x=>String(x.id)!==String(id));save();closeDrawer();render();toast('Team member removed')}
function team(c){
 ensurePlanningDefaults(); const people=db.team||[], jobs=projectedJobsForWeek(selectedDate).filter(x=>x.status!=='cancelled'); const assigned=jobs.filter(x=>x.assignee||x.assignedTo), unassigned=jobs.filter(x=>!(x.assignee||x.assignedTo)); const conflicts=[];
 for(const p of people){const mine=jobs.filter(j=>(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)===p.name).sort((a,b)=>(a.date+a.time).localeCompare(b.date+b.time));for(let i=1;i<mine.length;i++){const a=mine[i-1],b=mine[i];if(a.date!==b.date)continue;const gap=minsOf(b.time)-(minsOf(a.time)+Number(a.hours||0)*60),need=travelMinutes(a.location,b.location);if(gap<0||need!=null&&gap<need)conflicts.push(`${p.name}: ${a.name} → ${b.name}`)}}
 const coverage=jobs.length?Math.round(assigned.length/jobs.length*100):100;
 c.innerHTML=`<div class="headrow"><div><div class="smallcaps">People & workforce</div><h2>Team</h2><p>Availability, capacity, cost and assignments for everyone delivering CareWithJohn work.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openTeamEditor()">＋ Add team member</button></div><div class="grid kpis"><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Active people</div><div class="value">${people.filter(x=>x.status==='Active').length}</div><div class="sub">Ready for assignment</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Coverage</div><div class="value">${coverage}%</div><div class="sub">Upcoming work assigned</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Unassigned</div><div class="value">${unassigned.length}</div><div class="sub">Need an owner</div></div><div class="card kpi"><div class="label">Route issues</div><div class="value">${conflicts.length}</div><div class="sub">Overlap / travel</div></div></div><div class="sectionlabel">Team members</div><div class="list">${people.map(p=>{const h=jobs.filter(j=>(j.assignee||j.assignedTo)===p.name).reduce((a,j)=>a+Number(j.hours||0),0),cap=Number(p.maxHours||40),pct=Math.min(100,Math.round(h/cap*100));return `<div class="card"><div class="item" style="border:0;padding:0"><div><b>${esc(p.name)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(p.role||'Team member')} · £${Number(p.costRate||0).toFixed(2)}/h</div><div class="tiny muted">${esc(p.zones||'No zones')} · ${esc(p.services||'No services')}</div></div><button class="btn" onclick="openTeamEditor('${p.id}')">Edit</button></div><div class="coverage" style="margin-top:9px"><span style="width:${pct}%"></span></div><div class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:6px">${h.toFixed(1)}h scheduled / ${cap}h capacity · ${esc(p.status)}</div><div class="tiny muted" style="margin-top:3px">Availability: ${['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'].map(d=>`${d} ${p.availability?.[d]?.join('–')||'—'}`).join(' · ')}</div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="card muted">No team members yet.</div>'}</div><div class="sectionlabel">Workforce rule</div><div class="card"><b>Assignment is never based on availability alone.</b><div class="small muted" style="margin-top:5px">Planning checks time conflicts, travel between locations, preferred areas, service capability, workload and worker cost before recommending a person.</div></div>`;
}

</script>

</style>

<script id="cwj-family-phase4-js">
(function(){
 const FAMILY_NAV=['Home','Visits','Messages','More'];
 let familyPage='Home',familySelectedClient=null,familySelectedVisit=null,familyFeedbackClient=null,familyEarningsVisible=true;
 function familyUserName(){const u=cloudUser||{};return String(u.full_name||u.name||u.display_name||u.email||'').trim()}
 function familyRole(){const r=currentRole();return r===CWJ_ROLES.CLIENT||r===CWJ_ROLES.FAMILY_MEMBER}
 function familyActorLabel(){const raw=String(cloudUser?.role||currentMembership()?.role||'').toLowerCase();return raw.includes('family')?'Family Member':'Client'}
 function familyLinkedRelationships(){const ctx=currentAccessContext();return (ctx.relationships||[]).filter(r=>r.status!=='revoked'&&r.status!=='disabled')}
 function familyClientIds(){return [...new Set(familyLinkedRelationships().filter(r=>String(r.resourceType||'').toLowerCase()==='client').map(r=>String(r.resourceId)))]}
 function familyClients(){const ids=familyClientIds();return (db.clients||[]).filter(c=>ids.includes(String(c.id)))}
 function familyAuthorisedClient(id){return familyClientIds().includes(String(id))}
 function familyJobs(){return (db.jobs||[]).filter(j=>familyAuthorisedClient(j.clientId||j.personId||j.client_id||'')&&!['cancelled'].includes(String(j.status||'').toLowerCase())).sort((a,b)=>(String(a.date||'')+String(a.time||'')).localeCompare(String(b.date||'')+String(b.time||'')))}
 function familyVisit(id){return familyJobs().find(j=>String(j.id)===String(id))||null}
 function familyInitials(){const n=familyUserName()||'Family';return n.split(/\s+/).map(x=>x[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase()||'FW'}
 function familyClientName(c){return c?.name||c?.full_name||'Person you support'}
 function familyStatus(j){return j?.status==='completed'?'Completed':j?.status==='in_progress'?'In progress':j?.status==='exception'?'Needs attention':j?.status==='pending'?'Pending':'Confirmed'}
 function familyClientForVisit(j){const id=String(j?.clientId||j?.personId||j?.client_id||'');return familyClients().find(c=>String(c.id)===id)||null}
 function familyRenderNav(){const old=document.getElementById('cwjFamilyNav');if(old)old.remove();const n=document.createElement('div');n.id='cwjFamilyNav';n.className='cwj-family-nav';n.innerHTML=FAMILY_NAV.map(x=>`<button class="${familyPage===x?'active':''}" onclick="CWJFamily.go('${x}')">${x==='Home'?'⌂':x==='Visits'?'◷':x==='Messages'?'✉':'•••'}<br>${x}</button>`).join('');document.body.appendChild(n)}
 function familyShell(inner,title){const c=document.getElementById('view');c.innerHTML=`<div class="cwj-family-shell"><div class="cwj-family-top"><div class="cwj-family-title"><h1>${esc(title)}</h1><p>CareWithJohn · My Support</p></div><div class="cwj-family-avatar">${esc(familyInitials())}</div></div>${inner}<div class="cwj-family-bottom-space"></div></div>`;familyRenderNav()}
 function familyBoundary(){familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-lock"><div>🔒</div><div><strong>Your access is not yet linked to an authorised client relationship.</strong><div class="cwj-family-muted" style="margin-top:4px">CareWithJohn will not show client, visit, care, message or payment information until an explicit relationship authorises it.</div></div></div><div class="cwj-family-section"><div class="cwj-family-card"><h3 style="margin-top:0">Need help?</h3><p class="cwj-family-muted">Please contact CareWithJohn if you believe you should have access to a client record.</p><button class="btn primary" style="width:100%" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Help')">Help & Contact</button></div></div>`,'My Support')}
 function renderHome(){const cs=familyClients(),vs=familyJobs(),next=vs.find(j=>j.status!=='completed')||vs[0];if(!cs.length){familyBoundary();return}familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card cwj-family-hero"><div class="cwj-family-muted">${familyUserName()?`Good morning, ${esc(familyUserName().split(/\s+/)[0])}`:'Welcome'}</div><h2 style="margin:5px 0">Here’s your support</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">Only information authorised for your linked client relationship is shown here.</p>${next?`<div class="cwj-family-section"><div class="cwj-family-muted">Next Visit</div><h3 style="font-size:20px;margin:5px 0">${esc(next.date||'Date to be confirmed')} · ${esc(next.time||'Time to be confirmed')}</h3><div>${esc(next.service||'Support')} · ${esc(next.location||'Location not recorded')}</div><div style="margin-top:9px"><span class="cwj-family-pill good">${esc(familyStatus(next))}</span></div><button class="btn primary" style="width:100%;margin-top:12px" onclick="CWJFamily.openVisit('${esc(next.id)}')">View Visit</button></div>`:'<div class="cwj-family-empty" style="margin-top:12px">No upcoming authorised visits.</div>'}</div><div class="cwj-family-section"><h3>My Support</h3><div class="cwj-family-list">${cs.map(c=>`<div class="cwj-family-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(familyClientName(c))}</strong><small>${esc(c.type||'Support')}</small></div><span class="cwj-family-pill good">Authorised</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="cwj-family-section cwj-family-actions"><button class="btn" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Visits')">My Visits</button><button class="btn" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Messages')">Messages</button><button class="btn" onclick="CWJFamily.go('More')">More</button></div>`,'My Support')}
 function renderVisits(){const vs=familyJobs();familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-date-tabs"><button class="active">All</button><button>Upcoming</button><button>Past</button></div><div class="cwj-family-list">${vs.length?vs.map(j=>`<button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.openVisit('${esc(j.id)}')"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(j.time||'Time TBC')} · ${esc(j.service||'Support')}</strong><small>${esc(j.date||'')} · ${esc(j.location||'Location not recorded')}</small></div><span class="cwj-family-pill ${j.status==='completed'?'good':''}">${esc(familyStatus(j))}</span>›</button>`).join(''):'<div class="cwj-family-empty">No authorised visits are available.</div>'}</div>`,'My Visits')}
 function renderVisitDetail(id){const j=familyVisit(id);if(!j){familyPage='Visits';renderVisits();return}const c=familyClientForVisit(j);familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><span class="cwj-family-pill good">${esc(familyStatus(j))}</span><h2 style="margin:9px 0 4px">${esc(j.service||'Support')}</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">${esc(j.date||'')} · ${esc(j.time||'')} · ${esc(j.hours||'')} hrs</p><div class="cwj-family-field"><b>Support</b><div>${esc(familyClientName(c))}</div></div><div class="cwj-family-field"><b>Location</b><div>${esc(j.location||'Location not recorded')}</div></div>${j.notes?`<div class="cwj-family-field"><b>Visit information</b><div>${esc(j.notes)}</div></div>`:''}<div class="cwj-family-field"><b>Visit notes</b><div>${esc(j.delivery?.shareWithClient?j.delivery.note||'No shared note recorded.':'Only notes explicitly authorised for client/family viewing are shown.')}</div></div></div><div class="cwj-family-actions cwj-family-section"><button class="btn" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Visits')">Back</button><button class="btn" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Messages')">Message CareWithJohn</button></div>`,'Visit Details')}
 function renderSupportTeam(){const vs=familyJobs();const names=[...new Map(vs.filter(j=>j.assignee&&j.staffVisibleToClient).map(j=>[String(j.assignee),j.assignee])).values()];familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">My Support Team</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">Only team information explicitly marked as visible to this authorised relationship is shown.</p>${names.length?`<div class="cwj-family-list">${names.map(n=>`<div class="cwj-family-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(n)}</strong><small>Support team member</small></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`:'<div class="cwj-family-empty">No support-team details have been authorised for display yet.</div>'}</div>`,'My Support Team')}
 function renderMessages(){const ids=new Set(familyClientIds());const msgs=Array.isArray(db.messages)?db.messages.filter(m=>{const cid=m.clientId||m.personId||m.client_id;return cid&&ids.has(String(cid))&&m.visibleToClient!==false}):[];familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">Messages</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">Messages relating to your authorised support only.</p></div><div class="cwj-family-list cwj-family-section">${msgs.length?msgs.map(m=>`<div class="cwj-family-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(m.fromName||m.from||'CareWithJohn')}</strong><small>${esc(m.text||m.body||'')}</small></div><small>${esc(m.time||'')}</small></div>`).join(''):'<div class="cwj-family-empty">No authorised messages are currently available.</div>'}</div><div class="cwj-family-actions cwj-family-section"><button class="btn primary" disabled style="opacity:.55">New message — route not configured</button></div>`,'Messages')}
 function renderNotifications(){const ids=new Set(familyClientIds()),vs=familyJobs(),notes=[];vs.filter(j=>String(j.date)===todayISO()).forEach(j=>notes.push(['Visits',`${j.service||'Support'} at ${j.time||'scheduled time'}`,`${familyStatus(j)} · ${j.location||''}`]));const custom=Array.isArray(db.notifications)?db.notifications.filter(n=>!n.userId||String(n.userId)===String(currentAccessContext().userId)).filter(n=>!n.clientId||ids.has(String(n.clientId))):[];custom.forEach(n=>notes.unshift([n.type||'Important',n.title||'Notification',n.text||n.body||'']));familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-list">${notes.length?notes.map(n=>`<div class="cwj-family-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(n[1])}</strong><small>${esc(n[2])}</small></div><span class="cwj-family-pill">${esc(n[0])}</span></div>`).join(''):'<div class="cwj-family-empty">No authorised notifications.</div>'}</div>`,'Notifications')}
 function renderSupportPlan(){const cs=familyClients();const plans=cs.flatMap(c=>Array.isArray(c.supportPlan)?c.supportPlan:[]);familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">My Support Plan</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">This view only shows support-plan information explicitly made available through the authorised relationship.</p>${plans.length?`<div class="cwj-family-list">${plans.map(p=>`<div class="cwj-family-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(p.title||p.name||'Support item')}</strong><small>${esc(p.detail||p.description||'')}</small></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`:'<div class="cwj-family-empty">No support-plan information has been authorised for this account.</div>'}</div>`,'My Support Plan')}
 function renderPayments(){const cs=new Set(familyClientIds());const inv=Array.isArray(db.invoices)?db.invoices.filter(i=>i.clientId&&cs.has(String(i.clientId))&&i.visibleToClient===true):[];if(!inv.length){familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">My Payments</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">Payments and invoices are available only where financial access has been explicitly configured for this relationship.</p><div class="cwj-family-lock" style="margin-top:12px">🔒 No financial information is currently authorised for display.</div></div>`,'Payments / Invoices');return}const total=inv.reduce((s,i)=>s+Number(i.amount||0),0);familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><div class="cwj-family-muted">Current balance</div><div class="cwj-family-big">${familyEarningsVisible?money(total):'£•••'}</div><button class="cwj-family-pill" onclick="CWJFamily.togglePayments()">${familyEarningsVisible?'Hide':'Show'}</button></div><div class="cwj-family-section"><h3>Recent Invoices</h3><div class="cwj-family-list">${inv.map(i=>`<div class="cwj-family-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(i.number||i.date||'Invoice')}</strong><small>${esc(i.due||'')} · ${esc(i.status||'')}</small></div><b>${familyEarningsVisible?money(Number(i.amount||0)):'£•••'}</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`,'Payments / Invoices')}
 function renderFeedback(){const cs=familyClients();const cid=familyFeedbackClient||cs[0]?.id;familyFeedbackClient=cid;familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">Feedback</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">How was your support?</p><div id="cwjFamilyStars" class="cwj-family-stars" aria-label="Rating">★★★★★</div><p class="cwj-family-muted">Tell us what went well or what could be better.</p><textarea id="cwjFamilyFeedback" class="cwj-family-textarea" placeholder="Your feedback">${esc((db.feedback||[]).find(f=>String(f.clientId)===String(cid))?.text||'')}</textarea><div class="cwj-family-actions" style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn primary" onclick="CWJFamily.submitFeedback('${esc(cid||'')}')">Submit Feedback</button></div></div>`,'Feedback / Reviews')}
 function renderHelp(){familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">How can we help?</h2><p class="cwj-family-muted">Choose the area you need help with.</p>${['My Visit','My Support','A Staff Member','My Payment','Something Else'].map(x=>`<div class="cwj-family-field"><b>${x}</b><div class="cwj-family-muted">Contact CareWithJohn about this topic.</div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="cwj-family-card cwj-family-section"><h3>Contact CareWithJohn</h3><p class="cwj-family-muted">Use the authorised contact route configured for your account.</p><div class="cwj-family-lock">No external phone number or email route is assumed unless configured.</div></div>`,'Help')}
 function renderProfile(){const u=cloudUser||{},cs=familyClients();familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-card"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px"><div class="cwj-family-avatar" style="width:64px;height:64px">${esc(familyInitials())}</div><div><h2 style="margin:0">${esc(familyUserName()||'My Profile')}</h2><span class="cwj-family-pill">${esc(familyActorLabel())}</span></div></div></div><div class="cwj-family-card cwj-family-section"><h3>Contact Details</h3><div class="cwj-family-field">Email · ${esc(u.email||'Not recorded')}</div><div class="cwj-family-field">Phone · ${esc(u.phone||'Not recorded')}</div></div><div class="cwj-family-card cwj-family-section"><h3>Notifications</h3><div class="cwj-family-field">Visit reminders · On</div><div class="cwj-family-field">Messages · On</div><div class="cwj-family-field">Important updates · On</div></div></div>`,'My Profile')}
 function renderMore(){familyShell(`<div class="cwj-family-list"><button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Support Team')"><div class="grow"><strong>My Support Team</strong><small>People supporting your authorised care</small></div>›</button><button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Support Plan')"><div class="grow"><strong>My Support Plan</strong><small>Agreed support and preferences</small></div>›</button><button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Payments')"><div class="grow"><strong>Payments / Invoices</strong><small>Only when financial access is configured</small></div>›</button><button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Feedback')"><div class="grow"><strong>Feedback / Reviews</strong><small>Tell CareWithJohn how support is going</small></div>›</button><button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Notifications')"><div class="grow"><strong>Notifications</strong><small>Important updates</small></div>›</button><button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Profile')"><div class="grow"><strong>My Profile</strong><small>Personal details and preferences</small></div>›</button><button class="cwj-family-row" onclick="CWJFamily.go('Help')"><div class="grow"><strong>Help & Support</strong><small>Contact CareWithJohn</small></div>›</button></div>`,'More')}
 function renderFamily(){if(!familyRole()){const c=document.getElementById('view');c.innerHTML=accessBoundary();return}if(familyPage==='Home')renderHome();else if(familyPage==='Visits')renderVisits();else if(familyPage==='Visit Details')renderVisitDetail(familySelectedVisit);else if(familyPage==='Support Team')renderSupportTeam();else if(familyPage==='Messages')renderMessages();else if(familyPage==='Notifications')renderNotifications();else if(familyPage==='Support Plan')renderSupportPlan();else if(familyPage==='Payments')renderPayments();else if(familyPage==='Feedback')renderFeedback();else if(familyPage==='Help')renderHelp();else if(familyPage==='Profile')renderProfile();else renderMore()}
 function isFamily(){const ctx=currentAccessContext();return !!ctx.organisationId&&!!ctx.membership&&ctx.membership.status!=='disabled'&&(ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.CLIENT||ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.FAMILY_MEMBER)}
 function go(p){familyPage=p;renderFamily()} function openVisit(id){familySelectedVisit=id;familyPage='Visit Details';renderFamily()} function togglePayments(){familyEarningsVisible=!familyEarningsVisible;renderFamily()}
 function submitFeedback(cid){if(!familyAuthorisedClient(cid)||!roleAllows('communications.send_permitted'))return toast('Feedback is not available for this account.');db.feedback=Array.isArray(db.feedback)?db.feedback:[];const text=document.getElementById('cwjFamilyFeedback')?.value||'';db.feedback.unshift({id:Date.now(),clientId:cid,text,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),visibleToAdmin:true});save();toast('Feedback sent to CareWithJohn')}
 window.CWJFamily={go,openVisit,togglePayments,submitFeedback,render:renderFamily,isFamily};
 const previousRender=window.render;window.render=function(){if(isFamily()){renderFamily();return}previousRender()};
 const previousShowPage=window.showPage;window.showPage=function(p){if(isFamily()){if(p==='Today')familyPage='Home';else if(p==='Visit Delivery')familyPage='Visits';else if(p==='Team')familyPage='Profile';else familyPage=p;renderFamily();return}previousShowPage(p)};
})();
</script>
<script id="cwj-staff-phase3-js">
(function(){
 const STAFF_NAV=['Home','Visits','Messages','Notifications','Profile'];
 let staffPage='Home',staffSelectedVisit=null,staffEarningsVisible=true,staffTimer=null,staffTimerStartedAt=null;
 function staffUserName(){const u=cloudUser||{};return String(u.full_name||u.name||u.display_name||u.email||'').trim()}
 function staffTeamMember(){
   const uid=cloudUser?.id||cloudUser?.user_id||currentMembership()?.userId;
   const name=staffUserName();
   return (db.team||[]).find(t=>(uid&&String(t.userId||t.user_id||'')===String(uid))||(name&&String(t.name||'').toLowerCase()===name.toLowerCase()))||null;
 }
 function staffLabel(){return staffTeamMember()?.name||staffUserName()||'Team Member'}
 function staffAssignedVisit(j){
   if(!j)return false;
   const t=staffTeamMember(),name=staffLabel();
   return !!(t&&((j.assignee&&String(j.assignee)===String(t.name))||(j.assignedTo&&String(j.assignedTo)===String(t.name))||(t.userId&&String(j.assigneeUserId||j.assignedUserId||'')===String(t.userId)))) || (!!name&&String(j.assignee||j.assignedTo||'').toLowerCase()===name.toLowerCase());
 }
 function staffVisits(){return (typeof projectedJobsForWeek==='function'?projectedJobsForWeek(todayISO()):[...(db.jobs||[])]).filter(staffAssignedVisit).filter(j=>j.status!=='cancelled').sort((a,b)=>(String(a.date||'')+String(a.time||'')).localeCompare(String(b.date||'')+String(b.time||'')))}
 function staffCan(action,j){return !!(roleAllows(action)&&j&&staffAssignedVisit(j));}
 function staffVisit(id){return staffVisits().find(j=>String(j.id)===String(id))||null}
 function staffInitials(){return staffLabel().split(/\s+/).map(x=>x[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase()||'TM'}
 function staffStatus(j){return j.status==='completed'?'Completed':j.status==='in_progress'?'Active':j.status==='exception'?'Exception':'Scheduled'}
 function staffMoneyFor(j){return Number(j.workerCost||j.earnings||0)}
 function staffTodayVisits(){const d=todayISO();return staffVisits().filter(j=>String(j.date)===d)}
 function staffEarnings(){return staffVisits().filter(j=>j.status==='completed'||j.status==='in_progress').reduce((s,j)=>s+staffMoneyFor(j),0)}
 function staffRenderNav(){
   const old=document.getElementById('cwjStaffNav');if(old)old.remove();
   const n=document.createElement('div');n.id='cwjStaffNav';n.className='cwj-staff-nav';
   n.innerHTML=STAFF_NAV.map(x=>`<button class="${staffPage===x?'active':''}" onclick="CWJStaff.go('${x}')">${x==='Home'?'⌂':x==='Visits'?'▣':x==='Messages'?'✉':x==='Notifications'?'●':'◉'}<br>${x}</button>`).join('');document.body.appendChild(n)
 }
 function staffShell(inner,title){const c=document.getElementById('view');c.innerHTML=`<div class="cwj-staff-shell"><div class="cwj-staff-top"><div class="cwj-staff-title"><h1>${esc(title)}</h1><p>CareWithJohn · Staff / Team Member</p></div><div class="cwj-staff-avatar">${esc(staffInitials())}</div></div>${inner}<div class="cwj-staff-bottom-space"></div></div>`;staffRenderNav()}
 function renderHome(){
   const name=staffLabel(),today=staffTodayVisits(),next=today.find(j=>j.status!=='completed')||staffVisits()[0],earn=staffEarnings();
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card"><div style="font-size:13px;color:#707070">My Day</div><h2 style="margin:5px 0 0">Good morning, ${esc(name)}</h2><p class="cwj-staff-muted">${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long'})}</p></div>
   <div class="cwj-staff-grid cwj-staff-section"><div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-kpi"><b>${today.length}</b><span>Today's visits</span></div><div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-kpi"><b>${today.filter(j=>j.status==='completed').length}</b><span>Completed</span></div><div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-kpi"><div class="cwj-staff-money"><b>${staffEarningsVisible?money(earn):'£•••'}</b><button class="cwj-staff-eye" aria-label="Hide or show earnings" onclick="CWJStaff.toggleEarnings()">${staffEarningsVisible?'◉':'◌'}</button></div><span>Today's Earnings</span></div></div>
   <div class="cwj-staff-section"><h3>Next Visit</h3>${next?`<button class="cwj-staff-row" onclick="CWJStaff.openVisit('${esc(next.id)}')"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(next.time||'Time TBC')} · ${esc(next.name||'Client')}</strong><small>${esc(next.service||'Support')} · ${esc(next.location||'Location not recorded')}</small></div><span class="cwj-staff-pill ${next.status==='completed'?'good':'warn'}">${esc(staffStatus(next))}</span>›</button>`:'<div class="cwj-staff-empty">No assigned visits are available to display.</div>'}</div>
   <div class="cwj-staff-section"><h3>Alerts</h3><div class="cwj-staff-list"><div class="cwj-staff-alert">Only visits explicitly assigned or otherwise authorised for this Staff account are shown. No wider client access is assumed.</div></div></div>
   <div class="cwj-staff-section cwj-staff-actions"><button class="btn primary" onclick="CWJStaff.go('Visits')">My Visits</button><button class="btn" onclick="CWJStaff.go('Availability')">My Availability</button></div>`,`My Day`)
 }
 function renderVisits(){
   const visits=staffVisits();
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-tabs"><button class="active">All</button><button>Today</button><button>Upcoming</button></div><div class="cwj-staff-list">${visits.length?visits.map(j=>`<button class="cwj-staff-row" onclick="CWJStaff.openVisit('${esc(j.id)}')"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(j.date||'')} · ${esc(j.time||'Time TBC')}</strong><small>${esc(j.name||'Client')} · ${esc(j.service||'Support')} · ${esc(j.location||'Location not recorded')}</small></div><span class="cwj-staff-pill ${j.status==='completed'?'good':j.status==='exception'?'warn':''}">${esc(staffStatus(j))}</span>›</button>`).join(''):'<div class="cwj-staff-empty">No assigned or authorised visits are available.</div>'}</div>`,`My Visits`)
 }
 function renderVisitDetail(id){
   const j=staffVisit(id);if(!j){staffPage='Visits';renderVisits();return}staffSelectedVisit=id;
   const canStart=staffCan('visits.update_assigned',j),canFinish=staffCan('visits.complete_assigned',j);
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-detail"><div><span class="cwj-staff-pill">${esc(staffStatus(j))}</span></div><h2 style="margin:0">${esc(j.name||'Client')}</h2><div class="cwj-staff-field"><b>Service</b><div>${esc(j.service||'Support')}</div></div><div class="cwj-staff-field"><b>Date & time</b><div>${esc(j.date||'')} · ${esc(j.time||'Time TBC')} · ${esc(j.hours||'')} hrs</div></div><div class="cwj-staff-field"><b>Location</b><div>${esc(j.location||'Location not recorded')}</div></div><div class="cwj-staff-field"><b>Agreed tasks</b><div>${Array.isArray(j.tasks)&&j.tasks.length?j.tasks.map(t=>`<div class="cwj-staff-check"><input type="checkbox" ${t.completed?'checked':''} disabled><span>${esc(t.title||t.name||t)}</span></div>`).join(''):'No agreed tasks recorded for this visit.'}</div></div></div><div class="cwj-staff-actions">${j.status==='scheduled'&&canStart?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="CWJStaff.startVisit('${esc(j.id)}')">START VISIT</button>`:''}${j.status==='in_progress'&&canFinish?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="CWJStaff.activeVisit('${esc(j.id)}')">CONTINUE ACTIVE VISIT</button>`:''}<button class="btn" onclick="CWJStaff.go('Visits')">Back to My Visits</button></div>`,`Visit Details`)
 }
 function renderActive(id){
   const j=staffVisit(id);if(!j||!staffCan('visits.complete_assigned',j)){toast('This visit is not authorised for this Staff account.');staffPage='Visits';renderVisits();return}
   if(!staffTimerStartedAt)staffTimerStartedAt=j.delivery?.checkIn?new Date(j.delivery.checkIn).getTime():Date.now();
   const elapsed=()=>{const sec=Math.max(0,Math.floor((Date.now()-staffTimerStartedAt)/1000));return [Math.floor(sec/3600),Math.floor(sec/60)%60,sec%60].map((x,i)=>String(x).padStart(i?2:2,'0')).join(':')};
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card"><div class="cwj-staff-muted">Active Visit</div><h2 style="margin:5px 0">${esc(j.name||'Client')}</h2><div>${esc(j.service||'Support')} · ${esc(j.time||'')}</div><div id="cwjStaffTimer" class="cwj-staff-timer">${elapsed()}</div></div><div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-section"><h3>Agreed tasks</h3>${Array.isArray(j.tasks)&&j.tasks.length?j.tasks.map((t,i)=>`<label class="cwj-staff-check"><input type="checkbox" ${t.completed?'checked':''} onchange="CWJStaff.toggleTask('${esc(j.id)}',${i},this.checked)"><span>${esc(t.title||t.name||t)}</span></label>`).join(''):'No agreed tasks recorded for this visit.'}</div><div class="cwj-staff-actions cwj-staff-section"><button class="btn primary" onclick="CWJStaff.notes('${esc(j.id)}')">Visit Notes</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="CWJStaff.finishVisit('${esc(j.id)}')">FINISH VISIT</button></div>`,`Active Visit`);clearInterval(staffTimer);staffTimer=setInterval(()=>{const e=document.getElementById('cwjStaffTimer');if(e)e.textContent=elapsed()},1000)
 }
 function renderNotes(id){
   const j=staffVisit(id);if(!j||!staffCan('visits.complete_assigned',j)){toast('This visit is not authorised for this Staff account.');return}const note=j.delivery?.note||'';
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">Complete Visit / Visit Notes</h2><p class="cwj-staff-muted">${esc(j.name||'Client')} · ${esc(j.date||'')} · ${esc(j.time||'')}</p><label><b>Visit notes</b><textarea id="cwjStaffNote" class="cwj-staff-note" placeholder="Record the relevant visit note...">${esc(note)}</textarea></label></div><div class="cwj-staff-actions"><button class="btn" onclick="CWJStaff.activeVisit('${esc(j.id)}')">Back</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="CWJStaff.saveNotes('${esc(j.id)}')">Save Visit</button></div>`,`Visit Notes`)
 }
 function renderMessages(){
   const msgs=Array.isArray(db.messages)?db.messages.filter(m=>m.userId?String(m.userId)===String(currentAccessContext().userId):staffAssignedVisit(db.jobs?.find(j=>String(j.id)===String(m.visitId)))):[];
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">Messages</h2><p class="cwj-staff-muted">Relevant conversations only. Direct messaging routes that are not explicitly authorised remain unavailable.</p></div><div class="cwj-staff-list cwj-staff-section">${msgs.length?msgs.map(m=>`<div class="cwj-staff-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(m.fromName||m.from||'Conversation')}</strong><small>${esc(m.text||m.body||'')}</small></div><small>${esc(m.time||'')}</small></div>`).join(''):'<div class="cwj-staff-empty">No authorised conversations are currently available for this account.</div>'}</div><div class="cwj-staff-section"><button class="btn" disabled style="width:100%;opacity:.55">New message — route not configured</button></div>`,`Messages`)
 }
 function renderNotifications(){
   const vs=staffVisits(),notes=[];vs.filter(j=>j.status==='exception').forEach(j=>notes.push(['Important','Visit exception',`${j.name||'Visit'} requires attention.`]));vs.filter(j=>String(j.date)===todayISO()).forEach(j=>notes.push(['Visits',j.status==='completed'?'Visit completed':'Visit today',`${j.time||''} · ${j.name||'Assigned visit'}`]));
   const custom=Array.isArray(db.notifications)?db.notifications.filter(n=>!n.userId||String(n.userId)===String(currentAccessContext().userId)):[];custom.forEach(n=>notes.unshift([n.type||'All',n.title||'Notification',n.text||n.body||'']));
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-tabs"><button class="active">All</button><button>Important</button><button>Visits</button><button>Messages</button></div><div class="cwj-staff-list">${notes.length?notes.map(n=>`<div class="cwj-staff-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(n[1])}</strong><small>${esc(n[2])}</small></div><span class="cwj-staff-pill">${esc(n[0])}</span></div>`).join(''):'<div class="cwj-staff-empty">No authorised notifications.</div>'}</div>`,`Notifications`)
 }
 function renderAvailability(){
   const t=staffTeamMember();
   if(!t){staffShell('<div class="cwj-staff-empty">Your Staff profile is not linked to a team member record, so availability cannot safely be edited.</div>','My Availability');return}
   const days=['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'];staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">My Availability</h2><p class="cwj-staff-muted">Let us know when you are available to work.</p>${days.map(d=>{const a=t.availability?.[d]||['06:00','22:00'];return `<div class="cwj-staff-field"><b>${d}</b><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:7px"><input id="cwjAvFrom-${d}" type="time" value="${esc(a[0])}"><input id="cwjAvTo-${d}" type="time" value="${esc(a[1])}"></div></div>`}).join('')}</div><div class="cwj-staff-alert cwj-staff-section">Changes may need to be approved by Admin.</div><button class="btn primary" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px" onclick="CWJStaff.saveAvailability()">Save Availability</button>`,`My Availability`)
 }
 function renderEarnings(){
   const vs=staffVisits().filter(j=>j.status==='completed'),today=vs.filter(j=>j.date===todayISO()).reduce((s,j)=>s+staffMoneyFor(j),0),week=vs.filter(j=>{const d=new Date(j.date+'T12:00:00'),n=new Date();const monday=new Date(n);monday.setDate(n.getDate()-(n.getDay()+6)%7);monday.setHours(0,0,0,0);return d>=monday}).reduce((s,j)=>s+staffMoneyFor(j),0),month=vs.filter(j=>String(j.date||'').slice(0,7)===todayISO().slice(0,7)).reduce((s,j)=>s+staffMoneyFor(j),0);
   staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-grid"><div class="cwj-staff-card"><div class="cwj-staff-money"><div><b>${staffEarningsVisible?money(today):'£•••'}</b><span>Today</span></div><button class="cwj-staff-eye" onclick="CWJStaff.toggleEarnings()">${staffEarningsVisible?'◉':'◌'}</button></div></div><div class="cwj-staff-card"><div class="cwj-staff-money"><div><b>${staffEarningsVisible?money(week):'£•••'}</b><span>This Week</span></div><button class="cwj-staff-eye" onclick="CWJStaff.toggleEarnings()">${staffEarningsVisible?'◉':'◌'}</button></div></div><div class="cwj-staff-card"><div class="cwj-staff-money"><div><b>${staffEarningsVisible?money(month):'£•••'}</b><span>This Month</span></div><button class="cwj-staff-eye" onclick="CWJStaff.toggleEarnings()">${staffEarningsVisible?'◉':'◌'}</button></div></div></div><div class="cwj-staff-section"><h3>Visit Breakdown</h3><div class="cwj-staff-list">${vs.length?vs.slice(-12).reverse().map(j=>`<div class="cwj-staff-row"><div class="grow"><strong>${esc(j.date||'')} · ${esc(j.name||'Client')}</strong><small>${esc(j.hours||0)} hrs</small></div><b>${staffEarningsVisible?money(staffMoneyFor(j)):'£•••'}</b></div>`).join(''):'<div class="cwj-staff-empty">No completed assigned visits with earnings available.</div>'}</div></div>`,`My Earnings`)
 }
 function renderProfile(){const t=staffTeamMember();staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card"><div class="cwj-staff-profile"><div class="big">${esc(staffInitials())}</div><div><h2 style="margin:0">${esc(staffLabel())}</h2><div class="cwj-staff-muted">${esc(t?.role||'Support Worker')}</div><span class="cwj-staff-pill good">${esc(t?.status||'Active')}</span></div></div></div><div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-section"><h3>Contact Details</h3><div class="cwj-staff-field">Phone · ${esc(t?.phone||'Not recorded')}</div><div class="cwj-staff-field">Email · ${esc(t?.email||cloudUser?.email||'Not recorded')}</div><div class="cwj-staff-field">Location · ${esc(t?.location||'Not recorded')}</div></div><div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-section"><h3>Services I Provide</h3><div>${esc(t?.services||t?.capacity||'Not recorded')}</div></div><div class="cwj-staff-card cwj-staff-section"><h3>Documents & Training</h3><div class="cwj-staff-empty">Only authorised staff documents should appear here. No broader document access is assumed.</div></div><div class="cwj-staff-actions cwj-staff-section"><button class="btn" onclick="CWJStaff.go('Availability')">My Availability</button><button class="btn" onclick="CWJStaff.go('Earnings')">My Earnings</button><button class="btn" onclick="CWJStaff.go('Help')">Help / Contact Admin</button></div>`,`My Profile`)}
 function renderHelp(){staffShell(`<div class="cwj-staff-card"><h2 style="margin-top:0">Help & Support</h2><p class="cwj-staff-muted">We’re here to help.</p><div class="cwj-staff-field"><b>Contact Admin</b><div class="cwj-staff-muted">Use the authorised support route configured for your organisation.</div></div></div><div class="cwj-staff-alert cwj-staff-section">No external contact route is assumed here unless one is configured for this Staff account.</div>`,`Help / Contact Admin`)}
 function renderStaff(){clearInterval(staffTimer);if(!isStaffMember()){const c=document.getElementById('view');c.innerHTML=accessBoundary();return}if(staffPage==='Home')renderHome();else if(staffPage==='Visits')renderVisits();else if(staffPage==='Visit Details')renderVisitDetail(staffSelectedVisit);else if(staffPage==='Active Visit')renderActive(staffSelectedVisit);else if(staffPage==='Visit Notes')renderNotes(staffSelectedVisit);else if(staffPage==='Messages')renderMessages();else if(staffPage==='Notifications')renderNotifications();else if(staffPage==='Availability')renderAvailability();else if(staffPage==='Earnings')renderEarnings();else if(staffPage==='Profile')renderProfile();else renderHelp()}
 function isStaffMember(){const ctx=currentAccessContext();return !!ctx.organisationId&&!!ctx.membership&&ctx.membership.status!=='disabled'&&ctx.role===CWJ_ROLES.STAFF_MEMBER}
 function go(p){staffPage=p;renderStaff()}
 function openVisit(id){staffSelectedVisit=id;staffPage='Visit Details';renderStaff()}
 function startVisit(id){const j=staffVisit(id);if(!staffCan('visits.update_assigned',j))return toast('This visit is not authorised for this Staff account.');j.status='in_progress';j.delivery=j.delivery||{};j.delivery.checkIn=new Date().toISOString();staffTimerStartedAt=Date.now();save();staffPage='Active Visit';renderStaff()}
 function activeVisit(id){staffSelectedVisit=id;staffPage='Active Visit';renderStaff()}
 function toggleTask(id,i,checked){const j=staffVisit(id);if(!j||!staffCan('tasks.complete_assigned',j)||!Array.isArray(j.tasks)||!j.tasks[i])return toast('This task is not authorised for this Staff account.');j.tasks[i].completed=!!checked;save()}
 function notes(id){staffSelectedVisit=id;staffPage='Visit Notes';renderStaff()}
 function saveNotes(id){const j=staffVisit(id);if(!j||!staffCan('visits.complete_assigned',j))return toast('This visit is not authorised for this Staff account.');j.delivery=j.delivery||{};j.delivery.note=document.getElementById('cwjStaffNote')?.value||'';j.delivery.noteUpdatedAt=new Date().toISOString();save();toast('Visit notes saved')}
 function finishVisit(id){const j=staffVisit(id);if(!j||!staffCan('visits.complete_assigned',j))return toast('This visit is not authorised for this Staff account.');j.delivery=j.delivery||{};j.delivery.checkOut=new Date().toISOString();j.delivery.durationHours=j.delivery.checkIn?Number(((Date.now()-new Date(j.delivery.checkIn).getTime())/3600000).toFixed(2)):Number(j.hours||0);j.status='completed';save();staffTimerStartedAt=null;staffPage='Visit Notes';renderStaff();toast('Visit finished — add or review your notes')}
 function toggleEarnings(){staffEarningsVisible=!staffEarningsVisible;renderStaff()}
 function saveAvailability(){const t=staffTeamMember();if(!t||!roleAllows('availability.update_own'))return toast('Availability is not available for this account.');t.availability=t.availability||{};for(const d of ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat','Sun'])t.availability[d]=[document.getElementById('cwjAvFrom-'+d)?.value||'06:00',document.getElementById('cwjAvTo-'+d)?.value||'22:00'];save();toast('Availability saved');renderStaff()}
 window.CWJStaff={go,openVisit,startVisit,activeVisit,toggleTask,notes,saveNotes,finishVisit,toggleEarnings,saveAvailability,render:renderStaff,isStaff:isStaffMember};
 const originalRender=window.render;window.render=function(){if(isStaffMember()){renderStaff();return}originalRender()};
 const originalShowPage=window.showPage;window.showPage=function(p){if(isStaffMember()){if(p==='Today')staffPage='Home';else if(p==='Visit Delivery')staffPage='Visits';else if(p==='Team')staffPage='Profile';else staffPage=p;renderStaff();return}originalShowPage(p)};
 window.addEventListener('beforeunload',()=>clearInterval(staffTimer));
})();

// Production boot: establish authenticated cloud context before rendering any workspace.
// The approved role UI is loaded immediately after this part, so expose the boot promise
// and let that final UI layer perform the first render. This prevents a race where the
// legacy workspace renders before the approved Admin/Staff/Client/Family UI is installed.
window.cwjBootPromise=(async function cwjBoot(){
 try{
  await cloudMe();
  if(cloudUser) await pullCloud(true);
  return true;
 }catch(e){
  try{setSync('Sign in required','warn');}catch{}
  return false;
 }
})();
</script>
